Cisco AI Assistant med sestanki
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Včasih se boste morda pozno pridružili sestanku, boste morali stopiti stran za trenutek ali pa boste delali več stvari naenkrat in ne boste zbrani. S povzetkom UI pomočnika med sestanki se lahko hitro seznanite z informacijami, ki ste jih morda zamudili, razumete razpravo, zastavljate vprašanja, ne da bi prekinili sestanek, in ostanete na tekočem s pogovorom. Po sestanku boste prejeli tudi povzetek in prepis, ne da bi morali snemati.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle2](https://help.webex.com/images/video-two-home.png)
Izdelava avtonomnega AI agenta
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Izkušnja kupcev
Avtonomni AI agenti delujejo neodvisno brez neposrednih posegov ljudi. Avtonomni posredniki lahko dostopajo in uporabljajo hrambo znanja, da zagotovijo informativne in natančne odgovore na poizvedbe uporabnikov. Ti posredniki uporabljajo napredne algoritme in tehnike strojnega učenja za analiziranje podatkov, učenje iz okolja in prilagajanje njihovih dejanj za doseganje točno določenih ciljev.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle3](https://help.webex.com/images/video-three-home.png)
Vsebino dajte v skupno rabo med sestankom
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Ko vsebino daste v skupno rabo v aplikaciji Webex, lahko vsi na sestanku enostavno vidijo, o čem se pogovarjate. Vsakdo lahko daje vsebino v skupno rabo, vendar jo lahko istočasno deli zgolj ena oseba.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle4](https://help.webex.com/images/video-four-home.png)
Izboljšajte učinkovitost s pomočjo z AI ustvarjenih povzetkov
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Izkušnja kupcev
Cisco AI Assistant ponuja jedrnate povzetke predhodnih interakcij, ki posrednikom omogočajo nadaljevanje pogovorov brez prekinitev in potrebe po vnovičnem zbiranju informacij. Ta takojšnji dostop posrednikom omogoča, da se osredotočajo na zagotavljanje učinkovitih rešitev, ki omogočijo hitrejše razreševanje in bolj skladno izkušnjo kupcev.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle5](https://help.webex.com/images/video-five-home.png)
Aplikacija Webex | Dodajte sliko svojega profila
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Dodajte sliko v svoj profil, da vas bodo ljudje lahko lažje prepoznali v aplikaciji Webex. Dokler ne posodobite svojega profila , bo kazal samo vaše začetnice znotraj kroga.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle6](https://help.webex.com/images/video-four-home.png)
Obvestila premorov za boljše počutje pomočnika AI Assistant
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Izkušnja kupcev
Ko pomočnik AI Assistant priporoči premor za boljše počutje, se bo prikazalo obvestilo v pasici: Sprejemanje premora: Kliknite »Počitek«, da sprejmete premor. Pripomoček pomočnika Cisco AI Assistant se samodejno odpre, da potrdi vaš izbor. Po dokončanju trenutne interakcije se samodejno začne vaš 1-minutni premor za dobro počutje. Vaš status se spremeni na »Premor za dobro počutje«, kar prepreči uvrstitev naslednje interakcije v vašo čakalno vrsto. Po koncu vašega 1-minutnega premora se na zaslonu prikaže 5-sekundno odštevanje. Po koncu premora se njegovo okno samodejno zapre, vaš status pa se spremeni v »Na voljo«, kar pomeni, da ste pripravljeni na naslednjo interakcijo.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle7](https://help.webex.com/images/video-seven-home.png)
Izdelava povzetkov prostora
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Ko ste zasedeni ali že dolgo niste bili v pisarni, boste težko prišli na tekoče s svojimi prostori. UI pomočnik lahko ustvari povzetke prostora, ki vam bodo pomagali hitro pregledati vsebino zgrešenih sporočil in pogovorov v tem prostoru. Ostanite obveščeni o odločitvah, ključnih točkah in se na prvi pogled seznanite s pogovorom.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle8](https://help.webex.com/images/video-four-home.png)
Izboljšajte učinkovitost s prepisi v realnem času
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Izkušnja kupcev
Prepisi v realnem času so zasnovani tako, da vam pomagajo optimizirati učinkovitost komunikacije med interakcijo s strankami. Z zagotavljanjem prepisov v živo neposredno v aplikaciji Agent Desktop vam lahko pomaga izboljšati osredotočenost, jasnost in natančnost odzivov. Usmerjeno je v izboljšanje razumevanja in učinkovitosti med klici, zmanjšanje števila nesporazumov in nudenje podpore pri zagotavljanju interakcij visoke kakovosti, ki izboljšajo učinkovitost delovanja in zadovoljstvo strank.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle9](https://help.webex.com/images/video-nine-home.png)
Uporabite tablo med sestanki
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Ko ste zasedeni ali že dolgo niste bili v pisarni, boste težko prišli na tekoče s svojimi prostori. UI pomočnik lahko ustvari povzetke prostora, ki vam bodo pomagali hitro pregledati vsebino zgrešenih sporočil in pogovorov v tem prostoru. Ostanite obveščeni o odločitvah, ključnih točkah in se na prvi pogled seznanite s pogovorom.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle10](https://help.webex.com/images/video-ten-home.png)
Samozavestno se odzovite s pomočjo v realnem času
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Izkušnja kupcev
Pomoč v realnem času je funkcija pomočnika Cisco AI Assistant, ki je zasnovana tako, da vam daje podporo med interakcijo s strankami v živo, saj neprekinjeno razumeva vsebino pogovora, prepoznava namen stranke in takoj zagotavlja ustrezna priporočila. Vodi vas v realnem času ter vam predlaga, kaj lahko rečete ali storite, vodi vas skozi zapletene postopke in celo samodejno začne poteke dela.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle1](https://help.webex.com/images/video-one-home.png)
Cisco AI Assistant med sestanki
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Včasih se boste morda pozno pridružili sestanku, boste morali stopiti stran za trenutek ali pa boste delali več stvari naenkrat in ne boste zbrani. S povzetkom UI pomočnika med sestanki se lahko hitro seznanite z informacijami, ki ste jih morda zamudili, razumete razpravo, zastavljate vprašanja, ne da bi prekinili sestanek, in ostanete na tekočem s pogovorom. Po sestanku boste prejeli tudi povzetek in prepis, ne da bi morali snemati.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle2](https://help.webex.com/images/video-two-home.png)
Izdelava avtonomnega AI agenta
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Izkušnja kupcev
Avtonomni AI agenti delujejo neodvisno brez neposrednih posegov ljudi. Avtonomni posredniki lahko dostopajo in uporabljajo hrambo znanja, da zagotovijo informativne in natančne odgovore na poizvedbe uporabnikov. Ti posredniki uporabljajo napredne algoritme in tehnike strojnega učenja za analiziranje podatkov, učenje iz okolja in prilagajanje njihovih dejanj za doseganje točno določenih ciljev.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle3](https://help.webex.com/images/video-three-home.png)
Vsebino dajte v skupno rabo med sestankom
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Ko vsebino daste v skupno rabo v aplikaciji Webex, lahko vsi na sestanku enostavno vidijo, o čem se pogovarjate. Vsakdo lahko daje vsebino v skupno rabo, vendar jo lahko istočasno deli zgolj ena oseba.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle4](https://help.webex.com/images/video-four-home.png)
Izboljšajte učinkovitost s pomočjo z AI ustvarjenih povzetkov
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Izkušnja kupcev
Cisco AI Assistant ponuja jedrnate povzetke predhodnih interakcij, ki posrednikom omogočajo nadaljevanje pogovorov brez prekinitev in potrebe po vnovičnem zbiranju informacij. Ta takojšnji dostop posrednikom omogoča, da se osredotočajo na zagotavljanje učinkovitih rešitev, ki omogočijo hitrejše razreševanje in bolj skladno izkušnjo kupcev.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle5](https://help.webex.com/images/video-five-home.png)
Aplikacija Webex | Dodajte sliko svojega profila
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Dodajte sliko v svoj profil, da vas bodo ljudje lahko lažje prepoznali v aplikaciji Webex. Dokler ne posodobite svojega profila , bo kazal samo vaše začetnice znotraj kroga.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle6](https://help.webex.com/images/video-four-home.png)
Obvestila premorov za boljše počutje pomočnika AI Assistant
![Ikona za izdelke](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Izkušnja kupcev
Ko pomočnik AI Assistant priporoči premor za boljše počutje, se bo prikazalo obvestilo v pasici: Sprejemanje premora: Kliknite »Počitek«, da sprejmete premor. Pripomoček pomočnika Cisco AI Assistant se samodejno odpre, da potrdi vaš izbor. Po dokončanju trenutne interakcije se samodejno začne vaš 1-minutni premor za dobro počutje. Vaš status se spremeni na »Premor za dobro počutje«, kar prepreči uvrstitev naslednje interakcije v vašo čakalno vrsto. Po koncu vašega 1-minutnega premora se na zaslonu prikaže 5-sekundno odštevanje. Po koncu premora se njegovo okno samodejno zapre, vaš status pa se spremeni v »Na voljo«, kar pomeni, da ste pripravljeni na naslednjo interakcijo.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle7](https://help.webex.com/images/video-seven-home.png)

Izkušnja kupcev
Prepisi v realnem času so zasnovani tako, da vam pomagajo optimizirati učinkovitost komunikacije med interakcijo s strankami. Z zagotavljanjem prepisov v živo neposredno v aplikaciji Agent Desktop vam lahko pomaga izboljšati osredotočenost, jasnost in natančnost odzivov. Usmerjeno je v izboljšanje razumevanja in učinkovitosti med klici, zmanjšanje števila nesporazumov in nudenje podpore pri zagotavljanju interakcij visoke kakovosti, ki izboljšajo učinkovitost delovanja in zadovoljstvo strank.

Cisco AI Assistant v stretnutiach
![Ikona produktu](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Niekedy sa môže stať, že sa k schôdzi pripojíte neskoro, potrebujete sa na chvíľu vzdialiť alebo robíte viac vecí naraz, čo vás rozptýli. Vďaka súhrnom stretnutí AI Assistant môžete rýchlo dobehnúť to, čo ste zameškali, oboznámiť sa s diskusiou, klásť otázky bez toho, aby ste rušili schôdzu, a udržať si prehľad o konverzácii. Po stretnutí dostanete aj súhrn a prepis bez toho, aby ste potrebovali jeho nahrávku.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle2](https://help.webex.com/images/video-two-home.png)
Vytvorenie autonómneho AI agenta
![Ikona produktu](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Skúsenosti zákazníkov
Autonómni AI agenti fungujú nezávisle bez priameho zásahu človeka. Autonómni agenti môžu pristupovať k databáze znalostí a využívať ju na poskytovanie informatívnych a presných odpovedí na otázky používateľov. Títo agenti používajú pokročilé algoritmy a techniky strojového učenia na analýzu údajov, učenie sa z prostredia a prispôsobovanie svojich akcií na dosiahnutie konkrétnych cieľov.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle3](https://help.webex.com/images/video-three-home.png)
Zdieľanie obsahu počas schôdze
![Ikona produktu](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Pri zdieľaní obsahu cez aplikáciu Webex môže každý na stretnutí jednoducho zdieľať to, o čom sa diskutuje. Obsah môže zdieľať každý, no vždy len jedna osoba súčasne.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle4](https://help.webex.com/images/video-four-home.png)
Zvýšte efektivitu pomocou súhrnov generovaných umelou inteligenciou
![Ikona produktu](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Skúsenosti zákazníkov
Cisco AI asistent ponúka stručné súhrny predchádzajúcich interakcií, čo agentom umožňuje plynule pokračovať v konverzáciách bez potreby opätovného zhromažďovania informácií. Tento okamžitý prístup umožňuje agentom sústrediť sa na poskytovanie efektívnych riešení, čo vedie k rýchlejšiemu vybaveniu požiadaviek a jednotnejšej zákazníckej skúsenosti.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle5](https://help.webex.com/images/video-five-home.png)
Aplikácia Webex | Pridanie profilového obrázka
![Ikona produktu](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Umožnite ľuďom, aby vás mohli v aplikácii Webex ľahšie spoznať a pridajte si profilovú fotografiu. Kým ju nenahráte, v profile sa vám budú vnútri krúžku zobrazovať iba iniciály.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle6](https://help.webex.com/images/video-four-home.png)
Oznámenia AI asistenta o prestávkach na oddych
![Ikona produktu](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Skúsenosti zákazníkov
Keď AI asistent odporučí prestávku na oddych, zobrazí sa vyskakovacie oznámenie: Prijatie prestávky: Kliknutím na tlačidlo „Dať si prestávku“ prestávku prijmete. Miniaplikácia Cisco AI asistenta sa automaticky otvorí na potvrdenie vašej voľby. Po ukončení aktuálnej interakcie sa automaticky spustí vaša 1-minútová prestávka na oddych. Váš stav sa zmení na „Prestávka na oddych“, aby sa zabránilo zaradeniu ďalšej interakcie do vášho poradovníka. Keď sa vaša 1-minútová prestávka bude končiť, na obrazovke sa zobrazí 5-sekundové odpočítavanie. Po dokončení sa okno prestávky automaticky zatvorí a váš stav sa zmení na „K dispozícii“, čím budete pripravení na ďalšiu interakciu.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle7](https://help.webex.com/images/video-seven-home.png)
Generovanie súhrnov priestoru
![Ikona produktu](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Keď máte priveľa práce, prípadne ste mimo kancelárie, stíhať všetky svoje priestory môže byť náročné. AI Assistant dokáže generovať súhrny priestoru, ktoré vám pomôžu rýchlo dohnať zmeškané správy a konverzácie v priestore. Majte informácie o rozhodnutiach, kľúčových bodoch a majte rýchly prehľad o aktuálnych informáciách.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle8](https://help.webex.com/images/video-four-home.png)
Zvýšte efektivitu vďaka prepisom v skutočnom čase
![Ikona produktu](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Skúsenosti zákazníkov
Funkcia prepisov v skutočnom čase je navrhnutá tak, aby vám pomohla optimalizovať efektivitu komunikácie počas interakcií so zákazníkmi. Poskytovanie prepisov v skutočnom čase priamo v aplikácii Agent Desktop pomáha zvýšiť vaše sústredenie, zrozumiteľnosť a presnosť odpovedí. Cieľom je zlepšiť vaše porozumenie a efektivitu počas hovorov, znížiť počet nedorozumení a podporiť vás pri poskytovaní vysokokvalitných interakcií, ktoré zvyšujú váš výkon a spokojnosť zákazníkov.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle9](https://help.webex.com/images/video-nine-home.png)
Používanie tabule na schôdzach
![Ikona produktu](https://help.webex.com/images/product.svg)
Webex Suite
Keď máte priveľa práce, prípadne ste mimo kancelárie, stíhať všetky svoje priestory môže byť náročné. AI Assistant dokáže generovať súhrny priestoru, ktoré vám pomôžu rýchlo dohnať zmeškané správy a konverzácie v priestore. Majte informácie o rozhodnutiach, kľúčových bodoch a majte rýchly prehľad o aktuálnych informáciách.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle10](https://help.webex.com/images/video-ten-home.png)
Odpovedajte s istotou vďaka funkcii Real-time assist
![Ikona produktu](https://help.webex.com/images/helpdesk.svg)
Skúsenosti zákazníkov
Real-time assist je funkcia Cisco AI asistenta navrhnutá tak, aby vás podporovala počas interakcií so zákazníkmi naživo tým, že priebežne chápe kontext konverzácie, identifikuje zámery zákazníka a okamžite poskytuje relevantné odporúčania. Vedie vás v skutočnom čase navrhovaním toho, čo povedať alebo urobiť, pomáha vám orientovať sa v zložitých postupoch a dokonca automaticky spúšťa pracovné toky.
![play](https://help.webex.com/images/play-icon.svg)![footer.videoTitle1](https://help.webex.com/images/video-one-home.png)
Cisco AI Assistant v stretnutiach

## Ďalšie zdroje
![Stiahnite si Webex](https://help.webex.com/images/webex-symbol.svg)
Stiahnite si Webex
Jedna platforma so všetkými spôsobmi pripojenia.
![](https://help.webex.com/images/whiteArrow.svg)
![Komunita Webex](https://help.webex.com/images/webexCommunity.svg)
Komunita Webex
Komunita je centrom, kde sa môžete spojiť s kolegami a špecialistami spoločnosti Cisco, požiadať o pomoc, podeliť sa o svoje odborné znalosti, budovať sieť a profesionálne rásť.
![](https://help.webex.com/images/whiteArrow.svg)
![Webex Insider](https://help.webex.com/images/webexInsider.svg)
Webex Insider
Spojte sa s ľuďmi, ktorí zdieľajú vašu vášeň pre Webex, a získajte prístup k novým konceptom od tímov produktov a skúseností portfólia Webex.
![](https://help.webex.com/images/whiteArrow.svg)
![Webex pre vývojárov](https://help.webex.com/images/webexDevelopers.svg)
Webex pre vývojárov
Vytvorte budúcnosť obchodnej spolupráce so službou Webex. Získajte viac informácií o rozhraniach API a súboroch SDK Webex a vytvorte ďalšiu skvelú aplikáciu na spoluprácu na platforme Webex.
![](https://help.webex.com/images/whiteArrow.svg)
![Používateľ s ikonou náhlavnej súpravy](https://help.webex.com/images/needHelpImg.svg)

## Ako hodnotíte svoju skúsenosť s touto stránkou?

# Get started with Webex Meetings for hosts
![list-menu](https://help.webex.com/images/feedback.svg)Feedback?
Meetings makes hosting an online meeting easy. You can schedule a meeting in advance or start one right away. When it's time to meet, you can present and collaborate with your team as if you're in the same room. 
  * [](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrebr3c/Get-started-with-Webex-Meetings-for-hosts#id_133448)
  * [](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrebr3c/Get-started-with-Webex-Meetings-for-hosts#id_138094)


Certain features mentioned in this article are available only in paid plans. [Here's what comes with the free plan](https://help.webex.com/en-us/pagh8z/).
## Schedule a meeting
Sign in to User Hub and select Schedule. Fill in the necessary meeting information and select Schedule.
## Start a meeting
At the scheduled meeting time, sign in to User Hub. From the home page, under Upcoming Meetings, locate your meeting, and then select Start.
If you don't see your meeting, you can select View all meetings to see more scheduled meetings.
You can also [start a meeting in your Personal Room](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nyiuyli/).
## Connect audio
Before you join or start a meeting you can choose the settings you use for audio in the meeting.
  1. Click the audio connection options in the Meetings app.
  2. Choose how you want to hear the audio in the meeting:
     * Use computer audio—Use your computer with a headset or speakers. This is the default audio connection type.
You can change your headset, speakers, and microphone.
     * Call me—Enter or select the work or home phone number that you'd like the meeting to call.
     * Call in—Dial in from your phone when the meeting starts. A list of global call-in numbers is available after you join the meeting.
     * Don't connect to audio—You won't hear any audio in the meeting through your computer or phone. Use this option if you're in the meeting room but want to use your computer to share content in the meeting.
  3. If you want to join the meeting with your audio muted, click Mute![Mute](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450675.jpg) or, if you're joining the meeting from the app connected to a device, tap Mute device.
If you're on a room device and tap Mute device, the entire room is muted.
You'll see ![Unmute](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450407.jpg) when your microphone is muted. Click Unmute![Unmute](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450407.jpg) (or Unmute device if you're connected to a device) when you want to speak in the meeting.


## Start your video
Before you join or start a meeting, you can choose the settings you use for video in the meeting.
  1. If you want to join the meeting with your video turned off, click Stop video![Stop video](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450680.jpg).
You'll see ![Start video](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450406.jpg) when your video is turned off. Click Start video![Start video](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450406.jpg) when you want to show your video.
  2. By default, your self-view video shows in mirror view. You can [turn off mirror view](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nf4dwou/) if you want to see yourself in your self-view video the same way that other meeting participants see you.
If you're happy with the audio and video settings that you chose for this meeting, you can [save them](https://help.webex.com/en-us/oqq5p4/) for your next meeting.
  3. If you want added privacy or to limit possible distractions from your video, you can [use a virtual background](https://help.webex.com/en-us/80jduab/). Click Change background, and then choose to blur or replace your background.


To join the meeting from a compatible video device, [connect to a device](https://help.webex.com/en-us/by1t1x/).
## Share content
To share content during a meeting, from the meeting control panel, select Share![Share](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450684.jpg).
Go to the Share menu for more sharing options.
## Record a meeting
Your meetings are important. If your whole team can't be there, or if you want to remember what was said, record your meeting to share later. The recording includes the audio, video, and presentation.
While in your meeting, click Record![Record](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450685.jpg), and then Record to record right away. You and your participants see a red icon at the top right of your window when recording is in process.
When the meeting ends, you can find your recording on the recordings page of User Hub. If you recorded in the cloud, when the meeting ends, you receive an email with the recording link. Depending on file size and bandwidth, it can take up to 24 hours to receive your recording.
## High-quality video-supported cameras
Most PC-compatible cameras should work with Meetings. The following cameras were tested for high-quality video:
  * Cisco Precision HD 
  * Cisco VT Camera II
  * Cisco VT Camera III
  * Logitech HD Pro Webcam C910
  * Logitech HD Webcam C920
  * Logitech QuickCam C905
  * Logitech QuickCam Orbit AF
  * Logitech QuickCam Pro 9000
  * Logitech QuickCam S7500
  * Microsoft LifeCam Cinema
  * Microsoft LifeCam HD
  * Microsoft LifeCam NX-6000
  * Microsoft LifeCam VX-1000
  * Microsoft LifeCam VX-3000
  * Microsoft LifeCam VX-6000

# Join a Webex meeting
![list-menu](https://help.webex.com/images/feedback.svg)Feedback?
You can join a meeting from your computer, mobile device, phone, or video device. Choose the one that works best for you. 
We've made some changes to the options that are visible before you join a Webex meeting. If you have an earlier [Webex version](https://help.webex.com/en-us/qgij81/), these options may not be visible. Learn how to [join meetings on earlier Webex versions](https://help.webex.com/en-us/gzbfsi/).
When joining a meeting, IP addresses aren’t shared with other attendees.
Can't download? Here's how you can [join right from your browser](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-Meeting#id_135013).
![Join a meeting](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450832.jpg)
  * [Windows and Mac](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_134856)
  * [iOS and Android](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_135069)
  * [Web](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_135013)
  * [Phone only](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_134853)
  * [Video device](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#task-template_2bea19a3-cfd9-4e31-af0d-c474d25885cf)
  * [Frequently asked questions](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_135180)

  
| 1  |  Open your email invite and click Join meeting. If you don't have a meeting invite, [contact your meeting host](https://help.webex.com/en-us/WBX71898/). ![Join meeting from an email invite](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450866.jpg) If this is the first time you're joining a meeting, Webex automatically downloads the app. Click the installer file to install the app and follow the instructions.  If you're joining from a Linux computer or Chromebook, you aren't prompted to install anything. The meeting simply opens in your browser.  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Click Open  Webex if you're prompted to do so. Otherwise, click Launch meeting. ![Launching a meeting with Webex from your web browser window](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/456001-457000/456419.jpg)  |  
| 3  |  Enter your name as you want it to appear in the meeting, check Remember me, and then click Sign in so you can access the full list of meeting features. Or if you just want to join the meeting quickly and don't need access to all the meetings features, click Join as a guest.  |  
| 4  |  Enter your email address, check Remember me, and then click Next.  |  
| 5  |  Enter the meeting password that's in your email invitation and click Continue. ![Join meeting window highlighting how to join by meeting number from an email invite](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450874.jpg)  |  
| 6  |  In the preview window, you can make sure your audio and video sound and look good before you join the meeting. First, choose your audio. ![Join meeting preview window highlighting the audio option in Webex App](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450705.jpg)
  * Use computer audio (default)—Use your computer with a headset or speakers.
  * Call me—Enter a phone number, and Webex calls you. Depending on your host's Webex plan, you may or may not see this option.
  * Call in—If you prefer to use your phone for audio, dial in when the meeting starts. A list of global call-in numbers appears after you join the meeting. Make a note of the access code or meeting number and the attendee ID. You'll need to enter these numbers to join the meeting.Select one of the available numbers to join the meeting and when prompted, enter the access code or meeting number and the attendee ID. If you don't have your attendee ID, press # to wait in the lobby until someone in the meeting lets you in. Your attendee ID connects your name in the meeting to your audio. If you don’t enter your attendee ID, your audio connection appears as a call-in user in the Participants list, separate from your name, and you can’t control audio from the application.
  * Don't connect to audio—Use this option if you don't need audio. For example, you're in a conference room with your team, or someone already connected to the meeting from a video device. 

 |  
| 7  |  Click ![Unmute](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450407.jpg) if you want to say hi to everyone when you join.   |  
| 8  |  Click ![Start video](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450406.jpg) if you want to be seen when you join. To connect to a compatible video device, click Use video system. See [Connect to a video system from the desktop app](https://help.webex.com/en-us/c9htzk/) for more information.  |  
| 9  |  Click Join Meeting.  |  
If you're on the go, you can join your meeting from your Apple or Android phone, tablet, or Apple watch using the Webex mobile app. 
You'll be able to use video, chat with other participants, and share content.  
| 1  |  Tap Join meeting in your email invitation when it's time to join the meeting.  ![Tap Join](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/430001-440000/438001-439000/438122.jpg)  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Tap Download to install the Webex Meetings app and join the video conference. To join the meeting by phone only, tap the number on your screen. ![Download Webex Meetings window on Android and iOS](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/459001-460000/459366.jpg)  |  
| 3  |  Tap Open after the app installs and accept the Terms of Service and Privacy statement. If you’re joining a meeting for the first time on iOS, you must select the meeting link from your email invitation or calendar again to go to your meeting.   |  
| 4  |  Edit your name as you want it to appear in the meeting and enter your email address. Then, check the **Remember me** check box if you don't want to have to enter your name again the next time you join a meeting.  |  
| 5  |  Tap **Sign in** so you can access the full list of meeting features. Or if you just want to join the meeting quickly and don't need access to all the meetings features, tap **Join as a guest**.  |  
| 6  |  Tap OK If necessary, enter the meeting password—it's in the email invitation—and tap OK.  |  
| 7  |  [Change your audio and video settings](https://help.webex.com/en-us/ela6i8/#id_138214) before joining your meeting. ![Audio and video settings before joining a meeting window in Android and iOS](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/430001-440000/438001-439000/438123.jpg)
  * Use Internet for audio (default)—Use your phone with a headset or speakers.
  * Call me—Enter a phone number and Webex calls you. Depending on your Webex plan, you may or may not see this option.
  * Call in—If you prefer to use your phone for audio, dial in when the meeting starts. A list of the global call-in numbers is available in your meeting invite. Choose this option if your Internet connection is slow. Make a note of the access code or meeting number and the attendee ID. You'll need to enter these numbers to join the meeting. Select one of the available numbers to join the meeting and when prompted, enter the access code or meeting number and the attendee ID. If you don't have your attendee ID, press # to wait in the lobby until someone in the meeting lets you in. Your attendee ID connects your name in the meeting to your audio. If you don’t enter your attendee ID, your audio connection appears as a call-in user in the Participants list, separate from your name, and you can’t control audio from the application.
  * Don't Connect Audio—Use this option when you need to join a meeting and share content, and don't need audio. For example, you're in a conference room with your team, or someone already connected to the meeting from a video device. 

 |  
| 8  |  Tap Start video to preview how you'll look to others before you join the meeting.  |  
| 9  |  Click [Connect to a device](https://help.webex.com/en-us/c9htzk/#id_117874) to join the meeting from a compatible video device.   |  
| 10  |  Tap Join.  |  
Use the web app to join a meeting from your browser. This is the easiest way to join if you're using a Chromebook, a Linux computer, or you simply don't want to download anything.  
| 1  |  Open your email invite, and click Join meeting. ![Join meeting from an email invite](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450866.jpg)  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Webex starts preparing to connect you to your meeting. If you join from a Windows computer or Mac, click Join from your browser. If you join from a Linux computer or Chromebook, you won't be prompted to install anything. The meeting simply opens in your browser. You may see a meeting details page load, instead. If so, click Join Meeting. ![Launching a meeting with Webex from your web browser window](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/456001-457000/456419.jpg)  |  
| 3  |  Edit your name as you want it to appear in the meeting, check**Remember me** , and then click **Sign in** so you can access the full list of meeting features. Or if you just want to join the meeting quickly and don't need access to all the meetings features, click **Join as a guest**.  |  
| 4  |  If you're asked for a meeting password, enter the meeting password - it's in your email invitation - and click Continue. ![Join meeting window highlighting how to join by meeting number from an email invite](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450874.jpg)  |  
| 5  |  In the preview window, you can make sure your audio and video sound and look good before you join the meeting. First, choose your audio. ![Preview window before joining a meeting on web browser version of Webex App](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450782.jpg)
  * Use computer audio (default)—Use your computer with a headset or speakers.
  * Call me—Enter a phone number, and Webex calls you. Depending on your host's Webex plan, you may or may not see this option.
  * Call in—If you prefer to use your phone for audio, dial in when the meeting starts. A list of global call-in numbers appears after you join the meeting. Make a note of the access code or meeting number and the attendee ID. You'll need to enter these numbers to join the meeting.Select one of the available numbers to join the meeting and when prompted, enter the access code or meeting number and the attendee ID. If you don't have your attendee ID, press # to wait in the lobby until someone in the meeting lets you in. Your attendee ID connects your name in the meeting to your audio. If you don’t enter your attendee ID, your audio connection appears as a call-in user in the Participants list, separate from your name, and you can’t control audio from the application.
  * Don't connect to audio—Use this option if you don't need audio. For example, you're in a conference room with your team, or someone already connected to the meeting from a video device. 

If prompted, allow your browser to access your camera and microphone in order to see and hear what's going on in the meeting.  |  
| 6  |  Click ![Unmute](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450407.jpg) if you want to say hi to everyone when you join.  |  
| 7  |  Click ![Start video](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450406.jpg) if you want to be seen when you join. To connect to a compatible video device, click [Use video system](https://help.webex.com/en-us/c9htzk/).  |  
| 8  |  Click Join meeting.  |  
If you're experiencing [bandwidth](https://www.webex.com/business-continuity/business-continuity-low-bandwidth.html) issues, this is the way to go. 
When you dial into a meeting, you can hear everyone in the meeting, but won't be able to see anyone or what they share during the meeting.  
| 1  |  Open your meeting invitation and call one of the numbers under Join by phone. Depending on the host's meeting plan, your email invite provides a list of call-in numbers. If the phone numbers aren't provided in the email invitation, contact the meeting host. ![Join meeting window from an email invite on Windows and Mac](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/440001-450000/441001-442000/441348.jpg)  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Enter your meeting or access code, then press #. ![Join meeting window highlighting where to find meeting password from an email invite on Windows and Mac](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/440001-450000/444001-445000/444918.jpg)  |  
| 3  |  Enter your attendee PIN or ID, if you have one. If you don't, press # to be placed in the meeting lobby where the meeting host can admit you.  |  
Once you join the meeting, you'll be able hear everyone in the meeting but won't be able to see anything that's being shared.
[Join using a computer or mobile device](https://help.webex.com/en-us/ntwmx6b/) to see what's being shared in your meeting.
When you join a meeting from Cisco or third-party video devices, you can dial a SIP URI or IP address to join the meeting. 
**For SIP or H.323 devices**
**Join using video address:**
  1. Enter the meeting address. 
  2. If you're using a Webex device, follow the steps in [Join Webex meetings from Board, Desk, and Room Series](https://help.webex.com/en-us/pq3vkab/).


**Join using an IP address:**
  1. Enter the IP address.
  2. Enter the meeting number.


  * For 1234@example.webex.com, only SIP TLS is supported. 
  * For 1234@webex.com, SIP TCP, SIP TLS, and H.323 are supported.


[Do I need a Webex account to join a meeting?](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_135400)
You don't need a Webex account to join meetings that you're invited to. You do need an email invitation that provides the information you need to join the meeting. 
Reach out to your meeting organizer for the invite.
[How do I join using a meeting number?](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_134996)
If you have a Webex account, [sign in to your Webex site](https://globalpage-prod.webex.com/signin) and [enter the meeting number in the search box](https://help.webex.com/en-us/np1ja2fb/).![Joining a meeting by searching for the meeting number in the search box on your Webex site](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/430001-440000/439001-440000/439236.jpg)
If you don't have an account, [join by entering the meeting number on webex.com](https://globalpage-prod.webex.com/join).
[Why is there no audio?](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_134894)
If you're using your computer for audio:
  * The speaker or microphone volume may be low. [Adjust your speaker and microphone settings](https://help.webex.com/en-us/zf86fe/).
  * An [overloaded network](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nmghd9e/) can cause poor quality audio or video. Try turning off your video and other devices that may be using a lot of bandwidth. If all else fails, consider [dialing into your meeting for audio](https://help.webex.com/en-us/871cgu/).
  * If you join from your browser using the web app, you may need to allow Webex to use your microphone.


[Can I test my audio and video before the meeting? ](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_135011)
[Join a test meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nti2f6w/) to make sure your audio and video devices work as expected before your meeting. 
When you join a test meeting, it automatically downloads the Webex Meetings app - so it's easier to join your next meeting.
[How do I download the app?](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_135010)
When you click the join link in your email invite, the Webex Meetings app automatically downloads. You can also download it from webex.com.
[Download now](https://www.webex.com/downloads.html)
If you want to join without downloading anything, [join from your browser](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-Meeting#id_135013).
[How do I set up a meeting?](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_135007)
You must have a Webex account to [set up a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nrebr3c/). If you don't have an account, [sign up for a free account](https://cart.webex.com/sign-up-webex) and get started. 
[Why can't I record?](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nrbgeodb/Join-a-Webex-meeting#id_134751)
  * You may not be the host of the meeting. If you were invited to the meeting, ask the host to record.
If the host isn't in the meeting, a [cohost](https://help.webex.com/en-US/article/n1bqkbv/Add-Cohosts-for-Webex-Meetings-and-Webex-Events-\(New\)) assumes the host role and can record. Once the original host joins, they take back the host role and the ability to record.
  * Your site may be out of storage space. [Download](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n9r2sit/) recordings to back them up, then [delete](https://help.webex.com/en-us/ncfz8gcb/) them in User Hub to make space.
  * Recording may not be enabled. [Contact your Webex administrator](https://help.webex.com/en-us/7ksvf1/).
  * For free users, recording is only available from the desktop app. You can't record if you start a meeting from the web app using a Chromebook.
  * If [visual watermarks are added to shared content in a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/saxcjg/), your organization may prevent recording the meeting.

# Get started with Webex Calling
![list-menu](https://help.webex.com/images/feedback.svg)Feedback?
Get your bearings with all of the information available about Webex Calling, whether you're a partner, an administrator, or a user. Use the links provided here to help you get started using all of the services and features available with Webex Calling. 
Imagine being able to use enterprise-grade cloud calling, mobility, and PBX features, along with messaging, meetings, and calling from a Webex Calling soft client or Cisco device. That's exactly what Webex Calling has to offer you.
## Configuration in Control Hub (partners and administrators)
Control Hub ( [https://admin.webex.com](https://admin.webex.com/)) is a web-based management portal that integrates withWebex Calling to streamline your orders and configuration, and centralize your management of the bundled offer—Webex Calling, Webex App, and Meetings.
As a partner service provider, you can brand, market, and sell Webex Calling to your customers. You can set up and extend trials, deploy services for your customers, and create and provision orders for your customers. For more partner resources, see the [Webex Calling Sales Connect resources](https://salesconnect.cisco.com/#/program/PAGE-13367). (Requires partner credentials).
As a customer administrator on a trial or paid subscription to Webex Calling, you can set up your organization in the Control Hub by adding locations, licenses, phone numbers, calling features, users, and Workspaces (Room Devices that register to the Webex cloud).
Make sure that your environment supports Webex Calling by following the prerequisites and port reference material before you start specific configuration steps in the Control Hub. You can refer to the following configuration work flow diagram and the article links, in the order presented, to get your organization up and running with Webex Calling:
![](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/483001-484000/483714.jpg)
  * [Prepare your environment for Webex Calling](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n4cprps)
  * [Port reference for Webex Calling](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/b2exve)
  * [Configure Webex Calling for your organization](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/njvdjf2)
  * [Configure Local Gateway on IOS-XE for Webex Calling](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/jr1i3r)
  * [Configure Unified CM for Webex Calling](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nqqzbk7)
  * [Configure Webex Calling features](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/0r7a2z)
  * [Configure and manage Webex Calling users](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nz0krq9)
  * [Configure and manage Webex Calling devices](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n9r1aac)
  * [Adoption trends and usage reports](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nv7rohv/Adoption-Trends-and-Usage-Reports-for-Cisco-Webex-Calling)


For more information on the Webex Calling offer, see [Cisco Webex Calling in the Cisco Collaboration Flex Plan for End Customers Data Sheet](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/collateral/unified-communications/cisco-collaboration-flex-plan/datasheet-c78-741266.html).
## Webex App (users)
Webex App brings everyone together to do exceptional work: One, easy-to-use and secure app to meet, message and make calls. It supports various calling options and we've created several articles to help you make the most out of your calling experience, including how you can set up your own features:
  * [Webex App | Download the desktop or mobile app](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/krgc3ab/)
  * [Get started with Webex App](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3xx7vcb/)
  * [Webex App | Capacities](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n8vw82eb/)
  * [Webex App | Supported calling options](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/xga73p/)
  * [What's new in Webex Suite](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/)


## Webex Calling for Chrome (users)
The Webex Calling for Chrome extension provides Google Chrome users with access to a comprehensive suite of enterprise calling features that fits within your Google productivity workflow. For more information, see [Webex Calling for Chrome](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/a5ormz/).
## User Hub (users)
As a Webex Calling user, you can manage and configure your calling features and settings of your service, such as voicemails, call forwarding, and single number reach in User Hub. For more information, see [Access Webex Calling services in User Hub](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n5jqvam/).
## Phones and devices (users)
Webex Calling further provides an integrated user calling experience with Webex devices, including Cisco IP Phones 6800, 7800, 8800 Series desk phones, Cisco IP Conference Phones 7832 and 8832, Cisco IP DECT 6800 Series, Cisco Desk Phone 9800 Series, and analog ATAs. The following articles help you with getting up and running on these devices: 
  * [Get started with Cisco Desk Phone 9800 Series](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/29odsb/)
  * [Get started with your new desk and conference multiplatform phone](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n8h59x0)
  * [Get started with your new Cisco IP DECT 6800 Series](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nq28lbi)
  * [Get started with your Cisco ATA 191 and 192](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/bb93my)


## Availability
See the Webex Calling header in the [Where is Cisco Webex Available](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n6fwepj/#id_98285) article for countries where Webex Calling is available for sale.

# Webex App | Spaces and Teams
![list-menu](https://help.webex.com/images/feedback.svg)Feedback?
In Webex App, all your work takes place within spaces and teams. Here you can send messages, make calls, have video meetings, and share files and whiteboards. 
## Direct messages
![](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/410001-420000/417001-418000/417481.jpeg)
You [ send a message ](https://help.webex.com/en-us/zi4dpc/) directly to one person. The conversation that you started remains between the two of you, and you can't add other people to the conversation later.
## Spaces
![](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/410001-420000/417001-418000/417482.jpeg)
[Spaces](https://help.webex.com/en-us/hk71r4/) work well for a group of people working on a specific topic. You come together to handle this _thing_ (which can be something quick or long-term), but the focus is more narrow and specific. You could also hear these referred to as standalone spaces.
You can [join a space](https://help.webex.com/en-us/fyufh4/) when someone who's already in the space adds you to it.
Spaces start out unmoderated, which means anyone can do things like [add](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n35gqwcb/) or [remove](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n161k3p/) people, or [change the name and picture](https://help.webex.com/en-us/ktsmt5/). But if you need more control over who's joining, you can [make yourself a moderator of a space](https://help.webex.com/en-us/gw1w6c/). Then, only you can add people to the space, and you get other privileges like being able to [delete people's messages or files](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/rt2wbp/).
Non team members/guests can't moderate a space.
## Space sections
Organize and manage all your spaces into sections that you create. For example, easily drag and drop spaces to sections, to keep specific project work spaces together. Expand and collapse sections to give your space list a clean look. See [Webex App | Space sections](https://help.webex.com/en-us/uaayuo/) if you need help with organizing your spaces.
## Public spaces
[Public spaces](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/r78evy/) are spaces created within your organization which are easily discoverable. Discover, join or create public spaces and connect with people with similar interests, or keep up with the latest news. [Public spaces](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/r78evy/) are different from other spaces, as they aren't tied to a specific team. Anyone in your organization can find a public space that you create. If you change your mind, you can make a public space private again at any time.
## Space actions
Hover over a space, and right click or click More ![More Options button](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450687.jpg) to access more actions for the space.
  * **Peek** —See messages in the space without a read receipt.
  * **Add to favorites** —Add the space to the favorites section, or in your filtered list of favorite spaces.
  * **Add people** —Add others to the space.
  * **Open in new window** —Open the space in a separate window in the app.
  * **Notifications** —Brings you to the notification settings in the app.
  * **Copy space link** —Copies the link to that space.
  * **Edit space information** —If you have permission, you can edit the space information, including the name of the space, and a cover image.
  * **Move to section** —Move the space to any space section that you've created.
  * **Create section** —Creates a section with that space in the section.
  * **Hide** —Hides the space from your list of spaces.
  * **Leave** —Leave that space, and no longer see messages in the space.


## Teams
![](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/410001-420000/417001-418000/417480.jpeg)
If your original intention changes and that project outgrows its original purpose, you can [ create a team ](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n3kbxbf/) and then [ move a space into a team ](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nfzbl3p/).
Teams help you keep everything organized by putting multiple spaces under a common theme. Teams are great for a consistent group of people who are going to be working on _something_ for a long time. That _something_ can involve many activities, or could be subprojects happening at the same time.
To [ join a team ](https://help.webex.com/en-us/fr4sm5/), a moderator must add you to it.
You can also [ connect the team with a Microsoft 365 group ](https://help.webex.com/en-US/article/fyyrxq/Webex-%7C-Connect-a-Microsoft-365-Group-to-a-Team) when you're creating the team. You can then manage people in the team from Microsoft 365 and use Microsoft Sharepoint folders to save your files.
Every team has at least one team space,  General . You're automatically added to the  General  space when you're added to the team. As a team member, you can view and [ join any unmoderated team space ](https://help.webex.com/en-us/l0jhr4/) within the team. You can also [ create team spaces ](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nha7emp/) for others to join.

# Webex App | Find people, spaces, messages, files, and devices
![list-menu](https://help.webex.com/images/feedback.svg)Feedback?
You can search through the history of your conversations in Webex App to find people, spaces, messages, files, and even devices. You can search on everything, including space names, phone numbers or refine your search with filters, to narrow the results. And you can even make a call from the search results. 
![find people, spaces, messages, files, and devices using the desktop and mobile app](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/451001-452000/451678.jpg)
If your administrator adds external contacts, these contacts appear in search results.
  * [Desktop](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/iecbvc/Webex-App-%7C-Find-people,-spaces,-messages,-files,-and-devices#task_70F92E4947D75BAC14B844EC6F7B2F60)
  * [Mobile](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/iecbvc/Webex-App-%7C-Find-people,-spaces,-messages,-files,-and-devices#task_E3AD93953F0677EC39BFCA8AA64C906D)
  * [Web](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/iecbvc/Webex-App-%7C-Find-people,-spaces,-messages,-files,-and-devices#Cisco_Task.dita_11fe3e55-ffd7-42d5-ab64-2c12f4cb3c47)


The Webex App also searches contacts in Microsoft Outlook on Windows or your local address book on Mac, any search results are included in the lists.  
| 1  |  In the app header, click ![Search button](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/410001-420000/417001-418000/417390.jpg) Search, meet, and call, enter specific text, or any word in the name of a: Webex user, an email or video address for a person or a room device, or a space. Scroll through the results list and select who you're searching for. You can also make a call from the results list. After you enter a name, email address, or video address, just click Enter to make the call. If you're set up to call numbers, you can:
  * Copy and paste a phone number and press **Enter** to place a call.
  * Search for phone numbers by entering at least two digits for an extension search or three digits for a phone number using **starts with** and **ends with** searches.

 |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Select from Messages, Files, People, and Spaces to refine your search. To help you find a space, you can see the timestamp for the last message in that space. Type In:, From:, or With: directly in the search area, and then pick from the list to refine your search.
  * In:—enter the name of the space and choose a space from the list.
  * From:—enter a person's name and select the person from the list.
  * With:—enter a person's name and select the person from the list. The results include spaces you are in with this person. The results are ordered by the number of people in the space, starting with the smallest. For multiple spaces with the same number of people, these spaces are then ordered by the spaces with the most recent message.

You can use the In:  and From: filters together. You can only use the With: filter on its own. You can also [call someone directly in your results list](https://help.webex.com/en-us/4eliocb/). If the search isn't refined by using the In: , From:, or With: filters, you'll only see search results from your most recently viewed spaces. To view more results scroll back through your spaces list.  |  
| 3  |  Click Cancel to exit from your search.  |  
The Webex App also searches contacts in your local address book, any search results are included in the People list.  
|  Tap Search ![Search button](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/410001-420000/417001-418000/417390.jpg) and enter the text you're searching for. You can sort through the results using the lists of People, Spaces, Messages, Files, or Devices that match your text. If you're set up to call numbers, you can:
  * Copy and paste a phone number and tap ![Audio Call button](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/420001-430000/429001-430000/429940.jpg) to place a call.
  * Search for phone numbers by entering at least two digits for an extension search or three digits for a phone number using **starts with** and **ends with** searches.

 |  
| --- |  
| 1  |  Click Search ![Search button](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/410001-420000/417001-418000/417390.jpg) in the app header.  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Enter the text you're searching for. Select from People, Spaces, Messages or Files, to easily sort through the results.  |  
| 3  |  Click Cancel to exit from your search.  |

Get started with Webex Webinars
![list-menu](https://help.webex.com/images/feedback.svg)Feedback?
Webex Webinars comes with the advanced features you're familiar with from Webex Meetings. Whether you're launching a product or holding an all-hands, you can easily deliver a polished and interactive presentation. 
![Webcast view for attendes in Webinar](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/456001-457000/456413.jpg)
[Schedule a webinar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3rosq0/Get-started-with-Webex-Webinars#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_64b12e23-d21d-43fd-a007-dc55a4777b24)
Before you begin
[Compare experiences in Webex Webinars](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n80aayx/) to decide which attendee experience is best for your webinar.   
| 1  |  Sign in to [User Hub](https://globalpage-prod.webex.com/signin), click the Meetings tab, then click the Schedule drop-down menu and select Schedule a webinar.  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Enter the webinar information such as Topic, Webinar password, and Date and time.  |  
| 3  |  Select the Maximum attendees limit. Webinars will set the default attendee capacity to 1,000 for all, regardless of the maximum licensed capacity to optimize resource use. You can manually increase the attendee limit up to the licensed maximum if needed.   |  
| 4  |  (Optional) Select whether you want a webinars in webcast view. If you have more than 10,000 attendees, Webcast view for attendeees is automatically selected. Webinars in webcast view aren't available for Webex for Government.  |  
| 5  |  To help keep the webinar running smoothly, invite panelists to serve as subject matter experts.  |  
| 6  |  Click [Show advanced options](https://help.webex.com/en-us/bx9si3/Advanced-Scheduling-Options-for-Webex-Meetings-and-Webex-Events-New#Cisco_Reference.dita_14aa1156-de57-4328-9f6e-5a048856f8f1) to customize audio options, [require registration](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nlzg3uq/), hold a [practice session](https://help.webex.com/en-us/jml4sb/), and more.  |  
| 7  |  Click Schedule.  |  
What to do next
Once you've [scheduled your webinar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n2ox4qo/) and invited panelists, you can add attendees, either individually or by importing multiple attendees from one or more CSV files. For more information, see [Add attendees in Webex Webinars](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nsufj3u/).
[Start a webinar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3rosq0/Get-started-with-Webex-Webinars#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_722527c9-559f-49a8-81c9-e25a0be634da)  
| 1  |  Sign in [User Hub](https://globalpage-prod.webex.com/signin), then click Webinars.   |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Locate your webinar, and select Start. If you're hosting a webinar in webcast view, when you're ready to begin broadcasting, click Start webcast, choose the streaming layout, and then click Go Live.  |  
[Join a webinar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3rosq0/Get-started-with-Webex-Webinars#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_48e2e538-d2f8-4807-9c73-0f3048393c34)
When you're invited to a webinar, the host will send you an email invitation. You can register and join a webinar from the invitation.
If the attendee or panelist capacity has been reached, additional people can't join the webinar with that same role.  
| 1  |  Open the email invitation the host sent to you.  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Do one of the following:
  * If registration is required, click Register, enter your name and email address, and open the confirmation email once your registration has been approved.
  * If registration is not required, select Join webinar, enter your name and email address, and click Join webinar.

When you join a webinar in webcast view, it opens in your browser and begins once the host starts streaming the webcast.   |  
[ Webinar roles](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3rosq0/Get-started-with-Webex-Webinars#Cisco_Reference.dita_07d62cc1-5b76-4769-955a-e1011ab923f2)
What you can do in a webinar varies depending on the role you were assigned. Hosts and cohosts can assign roles to participants to create an interactive and engaging experience. Hosts can also [assign different chat privileges to attendees and panelists](https://help.webex.com/en-us/ndlbpk9/). For more information on the specific permissions and responsibilities of each role, see [Roles in Webex Webinars](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nme90adb/).
### Host
Hosts schedule and manage the webinar. They are able to assign roles to participants, as well as many of the same permissions as the other roles.
### Cohost
Cohosts have many of the same permissions as the host. This allows them to help the host manage a webinar or start them if the host is running late.
### Panelist
Panelists are the subject-matter experts speaking at your webinar. They can answer questions, chat publicly and privately, and more to moderate the webinar.
### Presenters
Presenters are the subject-matter experts speaking at your webinar who can share content with all participants.
### Note Taker
Note Takers write and publish notes, which can be referred to in the future or provide a summary for people who were unable to attend the webinar.
### Attendee
Attendees are the participants attending the webinar.
[Connect to audio](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3rosq0/Get-started-with-Webex-Webinars#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_f8b4ae9e-b320-4a21-85c7-fd3d049677e3)
You can connect your audio so your attendees can hear you. Learn how to adjust your audio settings and mute and unmute yourself during a webinar.  
| 1  |  Click the audio connection options in the Preview window.   |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Choose how you want to hear the audio: ![Connect to audio in Webex Webinar](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450765.jpg)
  * Use computer audio—Use your computer with a headset or speakers. This is the default audio connection type.  You can change your headset, speakers, and microphone.
  * Call me at—Enter or select the phone number that you want the webinar to call.
  * Call in—Dial in from your phone when the webinar starts. A list of global call-in numbers is available after you join the webinar.
  * Don't connect to audio—You won't hear any audio in the webinar through your computer or phone. Use this option if you're in the webinar but want to use your computer to share content.

Available audio options may vary depending on your site and account. If you have questions, [contact your site administrator](https://help.webex.com/en-us/7ksvf1/). For webinars in webcast view, the host, cohost(s), and panelists use Webex audio. The attendees can only use VoIP.  |  
| 3  |  If you want to join the webinar with your audio muted, click Mute![Mute](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450675.jpg). You'll see Unmute![Unmute](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450407.jpg) when your microphone is muted. Click Unmute![Unmute](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450407.jpg) when you want to speak in the webinar. You can also press your spacebar to temporarily unmute during your webinar. If you're joining a webinar as an attendee, you’ll automatically join the webinar with your audio muted. Only the host or cohost can unmute you. Webinar in webcast view attendees can't connect to audio.   |  
[Start your video](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3rosq0/Get-started-with-Webex-Webinars#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_54462dda-b374-4caa-94e1-f30606ce38fa)
Connect to video so attendees can see you during a webinar. 
Attendees can't connect to video before or during a webinar.  
| 1  |  If you want to join the webinar with your video turned off, click Stop video ![Stop video](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450680.jpg) You'll see Start video ![Start video](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450406.jpg) when your video is turned off.  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Click Start video ![Start video](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450406.jpg) when you want to show your video. By default, your self-view video shows in mirror view. You can [turn off mirror view](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nf4dwou/) if you want to see yourself in your self-view video the same way that other participants see you.  |  
| 3  |  Click Join webinar.  |  
[Share content](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3rosq0/Get-started-with-Webex-Webinars#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_53d82198-a0ec-4bdc-b3bd-4bc9e62bcb09)
Share content from your device to keep webinar participants informed and engaged. You can share your entire screen with others, or choose which files and applications you want to share so you can keep everything else private.
Attendees can't share content from their devices to other webinar participants.  
|  Select Share ![Share](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450684.jpg) in the webinar controls and choose what you are sharing to your participants. ![Share Content](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450878.jpg) For more information on how to share your screen, an application, a file, or a whiteboard, see [Share content in meetings and events](https://help.webex.com/en-us/yl90d9/).  |  
| --- |  
[Record a webinar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3rosq0/Get-started-with-Webex-Webinars#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_6526cf95-cf51-42a7-b8e8-0603a601dc4b)
Your webinars are important. If your whole team can't be there, or if you want to make recorded webinars available, record your webinar to share later. The recording includes the audio, video, and presentations.
When you schedule a webinar, you can enable [automatic recording](https://help.webex.com/en-us/bx9si3/) to begin when it starts. Your site administrator may have also enabled automatic recording for your site.
Automatic transcription of the audio is turned on by default. You can [turn it back on if you turned it off, or you can turn it on only for specific users](https://help.webex.com/en-us/uq5009/).  
|  While in your webinar, select Record![Record](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450685.jpg), and click Record. You and your attendees see the recording indicator ![Recording indicator](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/420001-430000/426001-427000/426040.jpg) in the Webex Webinars app window. When the webinar ends, you receive an email with the recording link. Your recording typically arrives within 24 hours after the webinar has ended, but this varies depending on recording size, site bandwidth, and other factors.  |  
| --- |  
You can [download a report on Q&A, chat, and polling activity for recorded webinars](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n1trzpx/) or [share recordings with others](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n462og5/).

Here you can find the information you need to install your Board, Desk, and Room Series devices. To ensure the best possible user experience, start your planning with looking at the room setup. 
## Room set up
In the Cisco Workspace Designer, you can find interactive models and recommendations that help you plan how to set up your video conferencing rooms. 
You can find the Workspace Designer [here](https://designer.cisco.com/).

# Get started with Webex Contact Center
![list-menu](https://help.webex.com/images/list-menu.svg)In this article
![list-menu](https://help.webex.com/images/feedback.svg)Feedback?
After creating a trial or subscription order, certain services need to be set up for the customer account on Control Hub. 
  * [Set up services for trials and subscription orders](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nee1mb6/Get-started-with-Webex-Contact-Center#id_106452)
  * [Services set up wizard](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nee1mb6/Get-started-with-Webex-Contact-Center#id_108387)
  * [Set up Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nee1mb6/Get-started-with-Webex-Contact-Center#id_129591)
  * [Set up your organization for hybrid services](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nee1mb6/Get-started-with-Webex-Contact-Center#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_196ff9c7-214b-46c7-9942-60064cf57d9b)


## Set up services for trials and subscription orders
A partner or a customer administrator can set up services for trials and subscription orders. Services setup wizard experience is the same for the trial and subscription provisioning flows. We recommend that partners complete these steps before handing over the account to customer administrators. 
You can use any [supported browser](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/fz1e4b/System-requirements-for-Webex-services#id_90868) to access Control Hub. 
**Partner Administrator Access**
  * **For Trials** : When you set up a new trial using the Start New Trial wizard, after you provide the information to start the trial, the final screen displays "Your trial is ready. Do you want to set up the services for the customer?". 
Click Yes to continue to set up services for the customer.
  * **For Subscription Orders** : When you create a [Webex Contact Center Order](https://help.webex.com/en-US/article/30mv2o/Create-a-Cisco-Webex-Contact-Center-Order-for-a-Customer) using the Order Set-Up wizard, after you specify the order information, the final screen displays "Thank you. The order has been mapped correctly". 
Click Next to continue to set up services for the customer.


**Customer Administrator Access**
**For Trials and Subscription Orders** : When the trial starts or the subscription order is successfully mapped, the customer administrator receives a Welcome email on the email address that is specified in the Start Trial wizard or Order Set-Up wizard. 
Do the following to access the customer administrator account on Control Hub:  
| 1  |  Open the Welcome email.  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  Click the Get Started link in the email.  |  
| 3  |  Enter the password and click Save & Sign In.  |  
| 4  |  Accept the Terms of Service to access your Control Hub account.  |  
## Services set up wizard  
| 1  |  After a contact center trial or subscription starts, access the Services setup wizard to configure the contact center tenant using the Control Hub URL <https://admin.webex.com/>. The wizard appears each time a partner or customer administrator accesses the Control Hub, until the setup is completed successfully.  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  On the Summary page, review the contact center license information and click Set up now.  |  
| 3  |  On the Calling Set up page, review the SIP address name of your organization and click Next.
  * You can modify the SIP address name if necessary. For more information, see the article [Webex SIP Addresses in Control Hub](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3ltzqcb).
  * You can configure the Webex Calling services for your organization if necessary. For more information, see the article [Configure Webex Calling for your organization](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/njvdjf2).

 |  
| 4  |  On the Contact Center set up  page, do the following: 
  1. Choose the country of operation from the  Country or region  drop-down list. You can't change the country of operation for Webex Contact Center after you click confirm. By default, the country of operation is same as the country that is chosen in the Order Mapping wizard. Webex Contact Center creates the tenant in the appropriate data center based on the country of operation. For the list of countries and the corresponding data center mapping, see the article [Data Locality in Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n0p6xa1). If an incompatible location message appears after you click Save, contact Cisco Solution Assurance for support.
  2. In the Time zone drop-down list, choose a time zone. By default, Webex Contact Center selects a timezone based on the region that your contact center operates from.
  3. The Webex Contact Center Telephony section shows your connection with Contact Center using Common Edge services, which is a shared edge infrastructure between Webex calling and Webex Contact Center. Click Next to proceed.

 |  
| 5  |  On the Review page, review the details of the subscription and click Submit. To change the service configuration options, click Back.  |  
| 6  |  Click Download Order Summary to download the summary of the order and click Close. After the Services Set up wizard completes, the Contact Center service is available in the customer organization.  |  
## Set up Webex Contact Center  
| 1  |  On the Control Hub home screen, navigate to Contact Center > Settings.   |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  In the Settings tab, click Set up Cisco Webex Contact Center.   |  
What to do next
Your tenant configuration is complete. Now, you can set up the following features for this tenant: 
  * Set up various entities for your tenant using the [Webex Contact Center Docmentation](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n2re5jy) article. 
  * Set up voice options using the [Set up voice channels for Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/2dputx) article.
  * Set up digital channels for your contact center using the [Set up digital channels in Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n954r0k) article.


## Set up your organization for hybrid services
Before you begin
  * Ensure that you have an order for Webex Connect or Google Contact Center Artificial Intelligence (CCAI) hybrid service. For information on how to place an order, see _[_Cisco Collaboration Flex 3.0 Contact Center Ordering Guide_](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/collateral/customer-collaboration/collab-flex-3-contact-center-og.html)_. 
  * Create your organization and map the order to the organization. For more information, see [Create a Webex Contact Center Order for a Customer](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/30mv2o).

  
| 1  |  Access the Services Setup wizard to configure the Contact Center tenant using the Control Hub URL <https://admin.webex.com/>. The wizard appears each time a partner or customer administrator accesses Control Hub, until the setup completes successfully.  |  
| --- | --- |  
| 2  |  On Summary, confirm that your Contact Center license information is accurate and click Set up now.  |  
| 3  |  On Set up Location, review the SIP address name of your organization and click Next.
  * You can modify the SIP address name if necessary. For more information, see the article [Webex SIP Addresses in Control Hub](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3ltzqcb).
  * You can configure the Webex Calling services for your organization if necessary. For more information, see the article [Configure Webex Calling for your organization](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/njvdjf2).

 |  
| 4  |  On Contact Center Set up, do the following:
  1. Choose the country of operation from the Country or region drop-down list.

You can't change the country of operation for the Webex Contact Center after confirmation. By default, the country of operation is the same as the country selected in the Order Mapping wizard. Webex Contact Center creates the tenant in the appropriate data center based on the country of operation.  For the list of countries and the corresponding data center mapping, see [Data Locality in Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n0p6xa1/). This list applies for On Premises and Webex Contact Center Enterprise also. For premise-based deployments, select a country of operation which provides services closest to your deployment.
  1. Review the information in Here’s what you’ll set up. The provisioned service is displayed in the Contact Center setup section.
  2. On Review, review the details of the subscription and click Submit. To change the service configuration options, click Back.
  3. Click the Download Order Summary (PDF) to download the order summary and click Close.

 |  
What to do next
  * If you are using Webex Connect service, provision digital channels for Webex Connect. For more information, see [Provision Webex Connect digital services for your organization](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nee1mb6/Get-started-with-Webex-Contact-Center#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_d7731baf-98fb-4a45-8f75-30984a38fa75).
  * If you are using CCAI hybrid services, configure digital channels for CCAI. For more information, see [Configure Contact Center AI](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/npbt02j).
