# Polls in Slido
![list-menu](https://help.webex.com/images/feedback.svg)Feedback?
Hosts can use live polls with Slido to engage participants during a meeting or webinar. Find out what you can do with polls as a host or participant. 
## Polls in Slido
![Polling in Slido](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/456001-457000/456414.jpg)
Slido is available in Webex Meetings and Webex Webinars. You can use Slido in Webex Meetings on [version 41.6 and later sites](https://help.webex.com/en-us/qgij81/), and in Webex Webinars on [version 41.9 and later sites](https://help.webex.com/en-us/qgij81/) and in Webex Suite meeting platform. Slido polls and Q&A in webinars are available for up to 10,000 attendees, while quizzes are available for up to 5,000 participants.
You can also create polls in webinars from the Polling panel, similar to Webex Meetings, even if Slido is not available in your webinar. For more information about polls that do not use Slido, see [Start a poll in Webex Meetings or Webex Webinars](https://help.webex.com/en-US/article/n0pdj9x/Start-a-poll-in-Webex-Meetings#task_6531E05B157C77BEEFF02E329A98FC3D).
Polls are a great way for meeting or webinar hosts to get input from participants. Use them to engage your audience, test knowledge, and ask for feedback.
As a meeting or webinar host, create and activate polls directly from Meetings by clicking Apps > Slido.
If you want to create polls before the meeting or webinar, [add a guest collaborator](https://community.sli.do/setting-up-a-slido-event-82/share-access-and-add-guest-collaborators-to-your-event-501) to help you create and run the polls, go to [https://www.slido.com](https://www.slido.com/), click Log In > Log in with Webex, and enter your Webex username and password.
During the meeting or webinar, the host or guest collaborator can launch polls. Participants can view and answer the questions.
There are a few different [types of polls](https://help.webex.com/en-us/37pot3/) hosts can create, including single poll questions, quizzes, and surveys.
### Hosts
Here are the tasks you can perform as a host:
  * [Create a poll](https://help.webex.com/en-us/007u2c/)
  * [Create a survey](https://help.webex.com/en-us/qpvziw/)
  * [Edit a poll](https://help.webex.com/en-us/ngvlwtu/)
  * [Activate a poll](https://help.webex.com/en-us/b3l3kc/) or [activate a quiz](https://help.webex.com/en-us/1bf2c3/)
  * [Reset a poll](https://help.webex.com/en-us/rk8p59/)
  * [Export and share poll results after a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nues53h/)
  * [Delete a poll](https://help.webex.com/en-us/r8oxz5/)


In case you only want to use the Q&A during your meeting or webinar, you can turn off polls. Go to [https://www.slido.com](https://www.slido.com/), click Log In > Log in with Webex.
### Participants
Here is the task you can perform as a participant:
[Answer a poll](https://help.webex.com/en-us/vtj0mf/)
### Known issues and limitations
Learn about [known issues and limitations for Slido](https://help.webex.com/en-us/o8hygt/) in Meetings.

### End of Support—iOS 17 and iPadOS 17
We are updating the system requirements for Webex App on Apple devices. Starting with the release of version 46.7 on July 7, 2026, we will officially end support for iOS 17 and iPadOS 17.
**Affected applications**
  * Webex App for iPhone and iPad
  * Webex for Intune app for iPhone and iPad


**Timeline**
  * New users: You'll no longer be able to download Webex App for iOS 17 or iPadOS 17, after July 7, 2026.
  * Existing users: You can continue using version 46.7 on these operating systems until February 2, 2027. We encourage you to upgrade your operating system before this date to ensure you continue to access the latest features and security updates. 
After February 2, 2027, Webex App will no longer function on these operating systems.

### February 11, 2026
### Webex Expands Data Residency Capabilities in Australia
Webex data residency in Australia is now live. Previously Webex Calling services were already hosted in Sydney and Melbourne data centers , and Webex meetings & Webinar primary data center was hosted in Sydney. With this latest expansion, we have also established backup data center for Webex Meetings and Webinars in Melbourne.
In addition, core Webex services including Messaging, Polling & Q&A (Slido), Translation & Transcription, Identity, Analytics, Key Management, AI Assistant, Logs and more, are now also data resident within Australia. This expansion supports our commitment to providing customers with secure, reliable, and locally hosted collaboration experiences. For more information, see [Data residency in Webex](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/oybc4fb/)

#### Changes to support for Windows 10
Webex will be dropping support for some old versions of Windows 10.
Beginning with Webex App 45.2 (February), Webex App’s minimum supported version of Microsoft Windows will be Windows 10 version 1809 (build 17763). Earlier versions of Windows were released in 2018 or before and no longer have mainstream support from Microsoft.
These versions will no longer be supported:  
| Name  | Codename  | Release Date  | Version  | Build  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| Windows 10  | Threshold  | July 29, 2015  | 1507  | 10240  |  
| Windows 10 version 1511  | Threshold 2  | November 10, 2015  | 1511  | 10586  |  
| Windows 10 version 1607  | Redstone 1  | August 2, 2016  | 1607  | 14393  |  
| Windows 10 version 1703  | Redstone 2  | April 5, 2017  | 1703  | 15063  |  
| Windows 10 version 1709  | Redstone 3  | October 17, 2017  | 1709  | 16299  |  
| Windows 10 version 1803  | Redstone 4  | April 30, 2018  | 1803  | 17134  |  
Starting in February, the Webex App on these versions of Windows will stop receiving updates, and Windows will need to be upgraded to continue using Webex. The last versions of Webex to support these legacy Windows operating systems will be:
  * Latest Channel customers: 45.1 (end of life: November 2025)
  * Slow Channel customers: 44.10 (end of life: August 2025) Please refer to our [support policy](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ne3khsm/) for more details on the lifespan of Webex App versions.

#### November 6, 2024
#### End of Life—Classic meetings associated with a space
As a reminder, we're ending support for Basic and Advanced meetings associated with a space (Classic meetings associated with a space). The meeting type will be deprecated across all remaining clusters between October 28 and November 18, 2024. Once the deprecation is complete, your static meeting links related to Classic meetings associated with a space will no longer work.
In October 2022, we released a new feature for meetings in spaces called [Improved Meetings Associated with a Space](https://help.webex.com/en-us/gxw5jz/). Unless you have a dependency on static meeting links or use our SDK guest to guest join flow, you should now have improved meetings associated with a space.
Customers who rely on static meeting links in spaces or who use our SDK guest to guest join flow are excluded from this notice. These customers will retain access to classic meetings associated with a space until their required features are made available.

## August (46.8)
### Improved sign-in experience—Web
We’ve streamlined your sign-in experience so you land directly in the Webex web app after signing in.
Now, you have one unified space for your meetings, messages, and calls. You can manage your work more holistically, stop switching between sites, and jump straight into your next task.
### Sign in to Webex using your social accounts—Web
It’s now easier to sign in to your Webex account using your existing Google, Apple, Microsoft, or Facebook credentials. By removing extra steps, we’ve made it simpler for you to access these options.
This feature is available for personal email domains. If you’re using an enterprise domain, you may be prompted to sign in using email or SSO instead if your organization has blocked social sign-in options.
[July (46.7)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_ece9ae0e-550c-4c47-b46c-d60b4c83b4f4)
We've no features to list this month, check out the coming soon for upcoming features or look through earlier releases below for features.

### Automatically save your settings—Windows
On Windows, your Webex settings now save automatically as you make changes, so you no longer need to select Save or Cancel. This creates a simpler, more accessible experience and keeps settings’ behavior consistent with other platforms. You can update preferences faster, with fewer steps and less interruption every time.
### New default virtual backgrounds—Linux
We updated our default virtual backgrounds to enhance your meeting experience with more modern workspace looks. We added six new high-quality virtual backgrounds. 
These updates provide a more appealing and consistent virtual environment for your meetings while reducing clutter from less-used backgrounds. We kept three popular existing backgrounds. We’ve removed the remaining old virtual backgrounds. If you were previously using a background that's been removed, it's been automatically replaced with one of our new background options.
You can continue to customize your background by selecting from the new defaults, using blur, or uploading your own images or videos. The app remembers your selection for future meetings, and you can change backgrounds anytime before or during a meeting or call.
![Virtual background images](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/490001-500000/495001-496000/495809.jpg)
See [Webex App | Use a virtual or blurred background in calls, meetings, and webinars](https://help.webex.com/en-us/0p4gb1/).
### Improved support for content sharing—Linux
We’re making screen sharing smoother for Linux users by automatically supporting the Wayland picker, so you can start sharing right away without needing to change a thing.
See . [Webex App for Linux](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/9vstcdb/) and [System requirements for Webex services](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/fz1e4b/)
### Yealink headset support—Mac
On Mac, you can now use more Yealink headsets with Webex App, and control them directly from within the app.
For a detailed list of supported platforms and models, see [Webex App | Headset Support](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nrivbbab/).

### Ask Me Anything: Unified conversational search with AI Assistant—Windows and Mac
Say goodbye to hunting through different tabs in the app to find the information you need. With the unified AI Assistant, you get the answers you need exactly where you are. Our unified AI acts as an Ask me anything tool for your entire Webex experience, pulling insights from your meetings, calls, and messages into one convenient place. 
See [Conversational search: Unified Ask AI Assistant](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ub8jcj/).
### Simplify Your calendar with AI Assistant chat-based scheduling—Windows and Mac
Stop juggling calendars and let AI Assistant handle the heavy lifting. Whether you’re setting up a new meeting or turning a follow-up item from a recap into a scheduled event, simply ask AI Assistant to do the work for you. 
AI Assistant automatically finds the best time for everyone involved, resolves conflicts, and bridges time-zone gaps—so you can spend less time planning and more time getting things done.
See [Schedule your meetings with Cisco AI Assistant](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/5yrxyeb/).
###  Cisco AI Assistant Salesforce Integration—Windows and Mac
The AI Assistant Salesforce integration seamlessly connects your Salesforce account with Webex, letting you interact with Salesforce data directly from the app. You can then use AI Assistant to create accounts, opportunities, leads, and add meeting summaries to opportunities, all from within Webex.
See [Cisco AI Assistant Salesforce Integration](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nls4f4j/).
###  Cisco AI Assistant Jira Integration—Windows and Mac
The AI Assistant Jira integration provides a direct connection between your Jira account and Webex App.
You can then use AI Assistant to create, update, and retrieve Jira issues, tasks, and projects directly from within the app.
See [Cisco AI Assistant Jira Integration](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/abevfb/).
### Flashing content detection extended to virtual backgrounds—Windows and Mac
If you’re sensitive to flashing or strobe effects, you can already set Webex to automatically dim any videos or graphics with flashing images that are shared during a meeting. 
Now, this protection also extends to virtual backgrounds. If someone uses a virtual background with flashing lights, Webex will dim those for you, too.
See [Dim flashing videos and images shared in a Webex meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n2qjz0v/).
### Video layout enhancement for Webex Relay—Windows and Mac
We've made it easier to customize your view in Webex Relay!
You can switch between the classic Grid layout or new Stack layout. The Stack layout features one large, prominent video centered at the bottom with a row of participant videos across the top.
### Webcast auto play for non-managed devices
We have streamlined how you join webcasts to ensure you are ready the moment the event begins.
  * If you join early, simply acknowledge the Webcast will start soon prompt, and your audio and video starts automatically once the session begins.
  * If you join after the event has started or prefer to trigger the start manually, you will see a Click to Start icon.


### Imprivata seamless logout for healthcare—Android
Just like on iOS, Webex App on Android now offers a seamless logout experience for Imprivata and Webex customers in healthcare. 
You can initiate a smooth logout process using the webexauth://logout URL.

### List view for Whiteboards Home tab—Windows and Mac
Switch between Thumbnail and the new List view in the Whiteboards home tab. See owner details, sort by name, last edited, or date created.
### Rich text in Whiteboards—Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android 
You'll have full control over how your text appears in text boxes, shapes, and sticky notes. Previously, formatting was limited to setting bold or italic for the entire text. 
With Rich text, you'll be able to apply detailed formatting down to each line, word, or even individual character.
### Find your Discover devices settings faster—Windows and Mac
We heard your feedback that finding the Discover devices settings used to feel like a bit of a treasure hunt. To make things simpler, we’ve moved these controls to a much more prominent location.
You can now find the Discover devices settings directly within the first level of your Devices settings. This update ensures that whether you are a new user or a seasoned pro, you can manage your connection preferences instantly and with fewer clicks.
See [Connect to a Webex device](https://help.webex.com/en-us/q7vr6m/) and [Stop automatically connecting to a Webex device](https://help.webex.com/en-us/p3zicc/).
### Copy and share your phone number—iOS and Android
Copy your phone number directly from both the avatar screen and the profile screen, and quickly share your contact information with others.

### Enable and view your telemetry data—Windows and Mac 
Webex App collects performance Telemetry data from your device and securely sends it to the cloud. This data helps Webex diagnose issues, improve reliability, and enhance the quality of calls and meetings. 
You can then view the data, or download it for offline review.

### New Invite people and Upgrade Plan options available on the navigation sidebar in Webex App—Windows and Mac
With the Invite people option, you can easily invite anyone to join you in Webex App. They’ll get an email invitation that contains a link to download the app and get started.
If you’re using a Webex free plan, you’ll also see a new Upgrade Plan option. Click this to explore the Webex plans available— from Webex Free to Webex Enterprise—and compare the features each one offers.

####  Cisco AI Assistant search with Amazon Q—Windows and Mac
When you enable a third-party search provider like **Amazon Q** , AI Assistant can seamlessly integrate with it.
This means AI Assistant can search across all your available data sources, to deliver comprehensive answers, ensuring you always have the information you need right when you need it.
This feature must be enabled by your organization administrator, and is only available to customers with an **Amazon Q** license.
See [Cisco AI Assistant search with Amazon Q](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/tkihjfb/).
#### Enhanced Global + Menu: Your Fast Lane to Productivity in Webex—Web
Experience a smarter, more streamlined workflow with the newly enhanced global + menu in Webex App on Web, located at the top of the window, right of the search bar. Now your key actions are always just a click away—tailored to your account and organization.
What’s New:
  * Centralized Actions: Instantly send a message, create a space, make a call*, schedule or start a meeting, or invite others to Webex—all from one convenient menu.
  * Adaptive Experience: The menu dynamically displays options based on your user type (Free, Paid, or Enterprise) and your organization’s enabled features, so you always see what’s relevant to you.
  * Modern & Intuitive: Located right next to the search bar, the refreshed menu provides fast access with a clean, user-friendly design.


***** Calling options available for users with the appropriate license.
Benefits:
  * Work Faster: Save time by accessing your most important actions from anywhere in the app.
  * Stay Focused: No more hunting through menus—everything that you need is at your fingertips.
  * Engage More: With easier access to core features, you can make the most out of Webex, every day.


Discover the power of the enhanced global + menu and take your collaboration to the next level!
See [Webex App | Start a conversation](https://help.webex.com/en-us/zi4dpc/), [Webex App | Create a space](https://help.webex.com/en-us/hk71r4/), [Webex App | Call someone using their name, email, or video address](https://help.webex.com/en-us/xhdf37/), [Webex App | Schedule a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/wy517z/), [Webex App | Quickly start a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/d91moy/), and [Webex App | Invite others to Webex](https://help.webex.com/en-us/rxs4hp/).
#### Quickly Download, Upgrade, Invite, and Discover What's New—Web
We’ve made some enhancements to Webex App on Web, in the sidebar of the app, you can now:
  * Download the desktop app with a single click, to get enhanced meeting features and more stability.
  * Upgrade your plan if you signed up for a free account to unlock premium capabilities and boost your productivity.
  * Quickly invite people to Webex, to help teams grow and collaborate without friction.
  * Access What’s New: click Profile picture > Help > What’s New for the latest feature announcements.


By making these options highly visible and accessible in the app on the left navigation bar, you can experience a streamlined experience, discover more value, and can act immediately, this removes friction and makes it easier to get the most out of Webex.
#### AI Agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot—Desktop
Easily connect your Webex account to use Webex AI Agent right in Microsoft 365. Access your Webex meeting data, including AI transcripts, summaries, and action items, all without leaving Copilot.
This feature must be enabled by your **Microsoft 365** administrator.
See [Webex AI Agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/z3tjcdb/).
#### Draw and select using your Apple Pencil - iPad
We’ve made it easier than ever to create and collaborate on your iPad! With the latest update, your Apple Pencil is dedicated to drawing—just pick it up and sketch, write, or illustrate ideas naturally. At the same time, your finger is reserved for selecting, moving, or resizing objects on the whiteboard. Effortlessly switch between drawing and interacting, making your whiteboard sessions smoother and more intuitive.
#### See your colleagues cursors on the whiteboard - Windows, Mac, iOS, Android
See all collaborators’ cursors on the whiteboard—whether they’re drawing or just pointing—by enabling a new option on your canvas. This setting is personal, so you control whether you see everyone’s cursors, without affecting what others see.

#### Easily Group and Move objects with Webex Whiteboard—Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android
Webex Whiteboard just got even smarter with the new grouping feature. Now, when you draw pen strokes inside images, sticky notes, or shapes, they automatically group together. If you stack objects-like putting a sticky note on top of an image-moving the bottom item will bring everything grouped with it. Want to split them up? Just drag the top pen stroke or object away to break the group.
Organizing and moving your ideas is now easier and more intuitive than ever!

We’re happy to announce Webex App support for ARM-based architecture on Windows PC's. ARM architecture offers improved battery life and performance—a big reason these devices are becoming more popular.

#### Improved whiteboard erase and undo experience - Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android
The whiteboard erasing experience is getting a major upgrade. Instead of undoing each erased pen stroke one by one, you'll now see all selected strokes become transparent as you erase. Once you release the eraser, all the marked strokes disappear together. If you change your mind, simply click the "Undo" button and all the erased strokes will instantly return in a single step. This update is designed to make your workflow faster and more intuitive.

#### End of Life for iOS 16 and iPadOS 16 starting September 2025, Version 45.9
Version 45.9 of Webex, which will be released in September 2025, will be the last version that supports iOS 16 and iPadOS 16. 
Which apps are affected: 
  * Webex App for iPhone and iPad available on Apple App Store. 
  * Webex for Intune app for iPhone and iPad available on Apple App Store. 


Timeline: 
September 2025: 
After version 45.9 becomes generally available in September 2025, no new Webex App updates will be available for existing users on iOS 16 and iPadOS 16. Existing users can continue using it until April 2, 2026. However, it is strongly recommended that users always upgrade to the latest released versions. 
New users on iOS 16 and iPadOS 16 will not be able to download and use the Webex App on iPhone and iPad after version 45.9. 
April 2, 2026: 
Existing users who have downloaded Webex App version 45.9 can continue using it for an additional 6 months, until April 2, 2026. However, it is strongly recommended that users always upgrade to the latest released versions. 
After April 2, 2026: Webex App version 45.9 on iOS and iPadOS will reach its end of life, and users will no longer be able to use the Webex App on iOS 16 and iPadOS 16.

#### Share private whiteboards for easy collaboration—iOS and Android
Share your private whiteboards with others in your company, even outside of meetings. When you share a whiteboard, your colleagues will receive a desktop notification inviting them to collaborate. The shared whiteboard will also appear in their "Whiteboards" home tab, making it easy for everyone to work together whenever they need. This new feature helps you collaborate seamlessly, no meeting required.
#### Set a default file location for recordings saved to your computer—Windows and Mac

This location is also where any files you download from a space are saved.

#### Laser pointer for whiteboards - Windows, Mac, iOS, iPad, Andoid
Introducing the new "Laser Pointer" tool for whiteboard sharing during meetings. This feature allows users to effortlessly highlight specific areas they're discussing, capturing attendees' attention. As you circle the content with the "Laser Pointer," a temporary trail appears, guiding viewers without altering the whiteboard. The trail automatically fades after a few seconds, ensuring the whiteboard remains clean and organized. Enhance your presentations and discussions with this intuitive tool, making collaboration more dynamic and focused.
#### Delete, rename, and open a whiteboard onto a paired Webex device - iOS, iPad, Android
Easily open a whiteboard on a paired Webex device with a single click. If your app is already paired with a Webex device, simply click to display the whiteboard. If not yet paired, the app will guide you through the pairing process, allowing you to open the whiteboard once pairing is complete.
#### Easily Share a whiteboard - Windows, Mac
You can now share private whiteboards with colleagues in your company, enhancing collaboration beyond meetings. Recipients receive desktop notifications, allowing them to access and contribute to the shared whiteboard anytime. The shared whiteboard also appears in their "Whiteboards" home tab for easy access, facilitating seamless teamwork and idea sharing.
#### Translate a post meeting summary—Windows and Mac
You can now translate previous meeting recording summaries into over 100 languages. Go to your Webex App settings, select General>Translation language, and choose your preferred language from the list. Once your language preference is set, go to the Meetings Tab, select Meeting recap and choose a meeting summary. You can then translate the meeting notes and action items by clicking the translate Icon.
#### Keep in-meeting chat message drafts - Windows, Mac
Introducing improved draft management for in-meeting chat messages. Now, if you get distracted and leave a message unfinished, your draft won't disappear. When you return to the chat, your draft will be waiting, allowing you to continue right where you left off without losing your train of thought. Stay focused and communicate effectively with this convenient feature.

#### New Whiteboard Home Tab in Webex App—Windows, Mac
We're excited to introduce an enhanced Whiteboards feature in Webex for improved visual collaboration. Use the new "Whiteboards" icon on the navigation sidebar to easily access all your whiteboards.

#### QR code scanner for hot desking—Android
When Android users try to scan a QR code to pair with a hot desk, Webex app won't open. To make things easier, we've added a 'Scan QR code' option directly in the app profile settings, so users can pair with hot desks seamlessly.
If you can't see this feature reach out to your organization administrator to enable it.
Administrators using a mobile device management (MDM) service, can also configure the feature on managed devices.
[November (44.11)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_5fb76c73-5faa-4aaa-b4da-071a6fc0fee3)
#### Reduce your energy emissions with Low Carbon Mode—Windows and Mac
Low Carbon Mode in Webex App, enables you to reduce your energy consumption when relying on high-carbon energy sources. Webex App receives a forecast of the carbon emissions on your local energy grid. In response, the app operates normally with low carbon sources like solar or wind, but when it's running on higher carbon sources such as natural gas or coal, it will postpone or scale back on energy intensive activities to cut down on carbon emissions. 
[October (44.10)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_943eef0b-2232-4dc2-a3bb-7d2c49617a52)
#### Automatically downgrade the VDI plugin so it’s compatible with Webex App—Windows VDI and Mac VDI
In earlier releases, if you had a newer version of the Webex App VDI plugin, VDI optimization might not work. But now, we’ve made things more flexible. If your Webex App VDI plugin version is newer than your app version, the VDI plugin automatically downgrades to match the app's version requirements. Plus, multiple versions of the Webex App VDI plugin are kept for future use.

#### Announcing Updated Protocol Support for New Webex Sites
We've introduced enhanced protocol support for newly provisioned Webex sites.
  * **For sites with the format [number]@webex.com,** you'll enjoy full support for **SIP TCP** , **SIP TLS** , and **H.323** protocols, ensuring robust and versatile connectivity options.
  * **For sites with the format [number]@example.webex.com** , only **SIP TLS** will be supported, providing a secure and streamlined communication experience.

#### Manage your calls from any hot desk device
Applies to Webex Calling.
Hot desk devices are now added to the device connection menu in the app. You can make and receive calls, hold or resume, transfer, and join conference calls, just like you do on your dedicated device.
[September (45.9)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_b1e28ea9-24a5-4d01-bdcd-3e4eddffb407)
#### Closed captions and live transcription for calls—Windows, Mac
Applies to Webex Calling.
Make every call clearer and more accessible with closed captions and a live transcription panel. This feature keeps you fully engaged, whether you're in a noisy environment, working in a different language, or you want to follow the conversation easily. 
Live transcription is available in English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and Italian.
[August (45.8)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_b23b9b80-e42e-4ff3-8f18-3f2af5bd9b89)
#### Full HD (1080p) video support for direct calls in Webex App—Windows and Mac
Applies to Webex Calling.
Webex App delivers 1080p full HD video for direct calls, offering crystal-clear, detailed visuals. Whether you're sharing a presentation or just chatting, everything looks sharper and more professional. Enjoy a smoother, more engaging experience with enhanced video quality.
#### Transform a conference into one-to-one call when only two parties remain—Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android
Applies to Webex Calling.
When only two people are left in a conference call, the call transforms to a one-to-one call. The conference host can access regular one-to-one call actions, such as call transfer.
See [Start a conference call](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nx5rj7s).
[July (45.7)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_ac927ede-f727-4124-87e4-f5cb35882313)
#### View line status for multiple lines—iOS and Android
Applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM).
When your administrator sets up multiple lines for you, you can easily check the status of each line directly from your mobile device. You'll see status indicators for each line: green for free, red for remote use, amber for local use, and flashing amber to let you know the line is ringing.
#### Control volume using your desk phone—Windows and Mac
Applies to Webex Calling. 
When you’re connected to your Cisco Desk Phone 9800 series, you can use either your desk phone or the app to mute your microphone or adjust the volume during a call. This gives you full control and a hassle-free experience.
#### Customize your Calling ringtone—iPhone and iPad
If you're using an iPhone or iPad you can now customize your Calling ringtone. Just go to Settings > Notifications > Calling, and choose a ringtone from the dropdown list.
#### Select individual ringtones for multiple lines—Android
If you're using an Android device, you can set specific ringtones for incoming calls on different lines. This way, you'll instantly know which line is ringing just by the sound.
[June (45.6)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_84753250-07f1-4fe8-bba1-06e8a3ab948c)
#### Full HD (1080p) video support for direct calls in Webex App—Windows and Mac
Applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM)
Webex App delivers 1080p full HD video for direct calls, offering crystal-clear, detailed visuals. Whether you're sharing a presentation or just chatting, everything looks sharper and more professional. Enjoy a smoother, more engaging experience with enhanced video quality.
[May (45.5)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_59207e63-7a35-4a75-bee5-4fc2f38ffb3c)
We've no calling features to list so far this month, check out the coming soon for upcoming features or look through earlier releases below for features.
[April (45.4)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_7b047605-7821-418a-92ce-a11853a8d8ed)
#### Enhanced SSO support for Unified CM calling with an external browser—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Android
**Applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM)**
Previously, you had to enter your credentials twice when your organization used Single Sign on (SSO) with external browsers (such as Edge, Chrome, Safari, Firefox). With this feature you only enter your credentials once and you’re signed in to both your calling service and the app. 
#### Multiple line support—iPhone, iPad, and Android
**Applies to Webex Calling**
In today’s multitasking world, phone power users can communicate on multiple lines while on the go, Multiline on mobile provides just that. This feature mirrors your desktop lines, making it easy to manage calls with different directory numbers efficiently. 
We started rolling out this feature in March and all users should see this by May.
#### Search by phone number—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Android
**Applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM), Webex Calling, and Webex for Service Providers**
You can currently search by name, and now you can also search by phone number. 
The search looks for matches using "starts with”, "ends with”, and “equals” criteria.
[March (45.3)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_be634383-43af-47f3-986e-7932de133b3c)
#### Support for Personal Call Routing (Personal Assistant)—Windows and Mac
**Applies to Webex Calling and Webex for Service Providers.**
We’ve added a new availability option of _Away_. You can set up personal call routing rules when you’re away from work and want to forward your calls or send them to voicemail. Callers hear a greeting with the reason you’re away and when you’ll be back.
#### Calling Dock support deskphone control—Windows
**Applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM)**
We've added desk phone control to the calling dock window. When you use the app to control your desk phone, you can quickly use the calling dock to make and receive calls and access mid-call controls for calls on your desk phone.
#### Phoneword support—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android
**Applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM) and Webex Calling**
Webex now lets you dial phonewords, so you can type in numbers like 1-800-FLOWERS right in the app. It automatically turns the letters into digits. No more guessing or manually converting numbers-just enter the phoneword, and Webex takes care of everything for you! Enjoy the convenience and accessibility of seamless dialing.
[February (45.2)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_e1989e50-1c27-4886-8686-183da8253581)
#### Only use your phone service on one device—iPhone, iPad, Android
**Applies to Webex Calling**
You can only receive call notifications on one mobile device at a time. If you sign in to another mobile device with the same account, with the next call notification you'll see a message to confirm you want to use this device for your phone services.
See [Error messages for Calling](https://help.webex.com/en-us/r75fdv/#Cisco_Reference.dita_33e612ee-d49d-484f-8387-0fe8cf9b7466).
#### Support for Jabra headset controls—Linux VDI
You can now use your Jabra headset controls during calls on Linux-based thin client VDI environments. For a detailed list of supported platforms and models, see [Webex App | Headset Support](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nrivbbab/).

#### Multiple line support—iPhone, iPad, and Android
**Applies to Unified CM**
If your administrator has set up your profile with multiple lines with different phone numbers for calling, they now appear in the mobile version of your app. You can switch lines if you need to make outgoing calls from different lines, such as a front desk line, support team line, or an individual line with a different caller ID.
#### Multiple line support for up to 10 lines—Windows and Mac
**Applies to Unified CM**
Your administrator can now set up your profile with up to 10 different lines. You’ll see the lines available in the app and can switch lines if you need to make or answer calls.
#### Call queue sign in/sign out enhancements—iPhone, iPad, and Android
**Applies to Webex Calling and Webex for Service Providers**
We’ve made some changes to how agents sign in and sign out.
As an agent, the options to sign in or sign out are now separate buttons, they are no longer available in the drop down list.
[November (44.11)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_0a6ffc6a-fcf9-413d-83ea-5387bf40c8e9)
#### Support for Personal Call Routing (Personal Assistant)—iPhone, iPad, and Android
**Applies to Webex Calling and calling provided by your Service Provider**
We’ve added a new availability option of _Away_. You can set up personal call routing rules when you’re away from work and want to forward your calls or send them to voicemail. Callers hear a greeting with the reason you’re away and when you’ll be back.
See [Webex App | Set up call routing for when you're away](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nxbj3ud/).
#### AI-generated summaries for call recordings—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Android
**Applies to Webex Calling**
When you play back a call recording in the app, you'll see an AI generated summary, listing the action items, and the full transcript from the call. So, you can quickly catch up on the discussion, and get a better understanding of the conversation at a glance.
If you can't see the AI call summary feature, contact your organization administrator.
#### Synchronized call history—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Android
**Applies to Unified CM**
You'll see synchronized call history across apps and all your devices. If your administrator configured multiple lines for you, each line's call entries are also synchronized across your devices. 
[October (44.10)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_05aa856f-a14c-42cf-bb1b-f69ea6842e74)
#### Increasing maximum resolution for individual video streams from 720p to 1080p
To improve video quality, we are increasing the maximum video resolution from 720p to 1080p. Previously sites had to request this capability to be enabled, this will now be enabled for all organizations as standard.
To send 1080p you must have a suitable device (for more details see [Webex video support](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/fw8u4j/)) and you must select 1080p in the camera settings.
If your organization wants to restrict the video back to 720p, you can contact Cisco support to submit a request.
#### Enhancements to the Calling tab—Windows and Mac
**Applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM)**
We’ve made some design changes to the calling tab in the app. These updates help to increase the value that you derive from the calling tab and include the following: 
  * Quick and intuitive access to the dial pad
  * Additional call history interactions on the more menu


[September (44.9)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_74167d3d-0797-4f2c-978a-60d087165611)
#### Move the share control bar to another monitor—Windows and Mac
**Applies to Unified CM, Webex Calling, and Calling hosted by a Service Provider**
If you use multiple monitors, when you share content in a call or meeting, now you can drag the share bar to a second monitor. This lets you focus entirely on presenting on your main screen.
#### Make call forwarding indicator more obvious—Windows and Mac
**Applies to Unified CM, Webex Calling, and Calling hosted by a Service Provider**
Previously, you may not have been aware that call forwarding was set and may have missed important calls. With this improvement, a call forwarding banner displays across all tabs in the app, and you can easily edit the forwarding destination or turn off call forwarding quickly.
![Call forwarding improvements](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/485001-486000/485312.jpg)
#### Use the system screen sharing picker—Mac
**Applies to Unified CM, Webex Calling, and Calling hosted by a Service Provider**
Now you can use the system screen sharing picker instead of Webex controls to share your screen, window, or an app in a meeting. Go to Settings on the navigation sidebar, click Sharing content, and check Use the system screen sharing picker. 
When you use the system screen sharing picker, you’re unable to share a file, your camera, a portion of your screen, your iPhone or iPad screen, or use the share optimization options. 
#### Use Apple CarPlay for calling and contacts—iPhone
**Applies to Unified CM, Webex Calling, and Calling hosted by a Service Provider**
When you connect your iPhone to a CarPlay-enabled vehicle using Webex, you can: 
  * View Recent Calls: You can view your recent calls directly from the vehicle's CarPlay-enabled screen and tap on any of the recent calls to make a call from the vehicle screen. 
  * Access Contacts: You have access to all your Webex contacts, and you can tap on any contact to make a call from the vehicle screen. 
  * Sort Contacts Alphabetically: Your contacts are sorted alphabetically (A to Z), which makes it easier for you to find and call the desired contact while driving. 
  * Navigate with Tabs: You can view and access your upcoming meetings, recent calls, and contacts through separate tabs, providing a streamlined experience. 


#### Call somebody using their extension—Windows and Mac
**Applies to Unified CM**
Click an extension to call somebody in your company. Extensions are added to contact cards, direct spaces, search results and call history. Administrators must configure this feature.

#### Updates to accessing calling options—iPhone and iPad

Choose the keys used for the shortcut or to use this shortcut when Webex is minimized or in the background, select Global.
#### Access call recordings—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Android
**The following feature applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM), Webex Calling, and Webex for Service Providers**
Any calls that you recorded are now available in the calling tab. 
#### Enhancements to the Calling tab—Windows and Mac
**The following feature applies to Webex Calling, and Webex for Service Providers**
We’ve made some design changes to the calling tab in the app. These updates help to increase the value that you derive from the calling tab and include the following: 
  * Quick and intuitive access to the dial pad 
  * Additional call history interactions on the more menu


[July (44.7)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_0b549a09-cc68-4389-b8ff-8ebebea23076)
#### Updates to accessing calling options—Android
**The following feature applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM), Webex Calling, and Webex for Service Providers**
We’ve improved the navigation to make it easier to find the dial pad. The dial pad remains in the floating action button, but other actions are removed. This means that for most people the floating action button becomes the dial pad button. 
For people that use Call Park Retrieve (Webex Calling) or Call Pickup (Unified CM), accessing these options is easier as they are now available in the floating action button.
See [Webex App | Call anyone with a phone number](https://help.webex.com/en-us/ndpb9acb/).
#### Support for LLDP with Emergency (E911) location tracking—Windows and Mac
**The following feature applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM), Webex Calling, and Webex for Service Providers**

**The following feature applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM), Webex Calling, and Webex for Service Providers**
The calling dock (multi-call) window can be resized to a smaller area and the size is dynamic and scales for different calling users (single line, multi-line or multi-line with BLF) depending on the number of lines and number of calls.
See [Webex App | Manage all your phone calls in one place](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n3t2z74).
#### Unread voicemail counter for non-visual voicemail—Windows and Mac
**The following feature applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM)**
When you have unread voicemails, you’ll see a counter on the Call Voicemail button on the calling tab.
#### Support extension dialing—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android
**The following feature applies to Calling in Webex (Unified CM)**
When your organization has set up extensions for internal dialing, you can use the app to make calls using the internal numbers. These internal numbers are visible for people on their contact cards in the app. 
#### Call queue sign in/sign out enhancements—Windows and Mac
**The following feature applies to Webex Calling, and Webex for Service Providers**
We’ve made some changes to how agents sign in and sign out. 
As an agent, the options to sign in or sign out are now separate buttons, they are no longer available in the drop down list. 
![Agent sign out of queue](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/484001-485000/484366.jpg)
For Webex Calling Customer Assist as a supervisor, you can’t change the state for agents that you manage in queues until that agent has signed in.

####  Webex Calling Customer Assist bounced calls—Windows and Mac
**The following feature applies to Webex Calling, and Webex for Service Providers**
This applies to Webex Calling Customer Assist.
As an agent, when your administrator has configured a bounced call policy, if you miss a call, you'll receive a bounced call notification and your status is changed to unavailable. When your status is unavailable, calls are not routed to you.

**The following feature applies to Webex Calling, and Webex for Service Providers**

**The following feature applies to Webex Calling, and Webex for Service Providers**

## August (46.8)
### Open meeting chat from the floating mini window—Windows and Mac
When you're [multitasking during a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/9xq0y3/) on desktop, you'll be able to open in-meeting chat directly from the floating mini window. If you have unread messages, a blue dot appears on the chat button ![Unread meeting messages indicator](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/460001-470000/469001-470000/469800.jpg) so you can see at a glance when new messages arrive.
[July (46.7)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_42177a11-0e57-4ab4-b292-c85817363653)
### Auto video layout—Windows and Mac
We're adding a new meeting layout option for desktop users called Auto. When you resize your meeting window, your layout now adjusts automatically to make better use of space and help you focus on what matters most. Depending on the shape of your window, Webex can switch between Stack and Side by side views, adjust the filmstrip, and give more space to people or shared content. In larger meetings, you'll see the active speaker displayed more prominently. 
To allow you to focus on the meeting, the controls fade away automatically until you move your mouse over the app. If you prefer to have them always on, toggle Automatically hide all controls off under the Layout menu.
See [Webex App | Change your video layout during a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n4f1ptt/).
### Dock or pop out the closed captions box—Windows and Mac
You can now choose the closed caption mode that works best for you in meetings. Keep captions in a movable floating box, or dock them to the bottom of the meeting window so they don't cover shared content or other on-screen information.
See [Webex App | Dock or pop out closed captions in a meeting or webinar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/xxzgzf/).
### Disable emojis and GIFs in meeting and webinar chats—Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, and Web
We're adding administrator controls to disable emojis, GIFs, or both in meeting and webinar chats.
This helps organizations keep chats appropriate for formal sessions, and regulated environments, while leaving the standard chat experience unchanged unless the option is selected.
### 5K content sharing—Windows and Mac
We're adding support for sharing content in up to 5K resolution from Webex.
This helps people with ultra-wide, dense, or multi-monitor workflows share detailed content more clearly while keeping lower-resolution sharing fast.
See [Webex App | Set the maximum content resolution for shared content](https://help.webex.com/en-us/lb6ciy/).
[June (46.6)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_fcb61f26-1d0c-4388-a80f-415ccf7ed781)
### Avoid delays with pre-meeting permission checks—Mac
When your calendar is connected to the app, Webex now alerts you if your microphone, camera, or screen sharing permissions need attention so you can fix them before your meeting starts.
![A banner about pre-meeting checks for your mic, camera, and screen share.](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/490001-500000/496001-497000/496907.jpg)
### Switch between your iPad and external USB-C cameras—iPad
On your iPad, you can switch between the built-in and external USB-C cameras during a meeting from the More options menu in your self-view video. You can also change your camera preference anytime in Settings > Video. Changes apply immediately.
Webex defaults to your external camera when one is connected before you join. If you choose the built-in camera, connecting or disconnecting an external device won’t interrupt your video. For those who prefer external hardware, the app automatically detects and switches to any available external camera to keep you connected.
![Use built-in camera option in your self view video](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/490001-500000/496001-497000/496908.jpg)
See [Webex App | Use an external camera for calls or meetings on your iPad](https://help.webex.com/en-us/ni087rbb/).
### Improved post-meeting experience for guest users—iPhone, iPad, and Android
Now, when guests leave a meeting, they’ll see a redesigned landing page that makes it easier for them to stay connected and engaged. Here’s how guests can benefit from the new experience:
  * Share feedback: quickly give feedback about how the meeting went.
  * Explore Webex: brief overview of the benefits of using Webex.
  * Take action: guests can sign up for a Webex account, rejoin the meeting, or download the Webex desktop app.


If you or your organization have [configured a custom URL for your post-meeting landing page](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nk21f0t/), your guests will be directed to that specific page in a new browser tab instead of the default experience.
See [Webex App | Join a meeting as a guest](https://help.webex.com/en-us/49769d/) and [Webex App | Leave or end a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n9hodudb/).
[May (46.5)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_04ad4889-5b3e-4487-a9fc-a336134e13ef)
### Hide or show in-meeting notifications—Windows and Mac
You now have more control over your meeting notifications. You can choose to show or hide optional alerts for in-meeting chat, raised hands, and role updates, even while you’re sharing content.
Mandatory notifications, such as those for recordings, AI assistant, and lobby updates, remain enabled and are not affected by these settings.
See [Webex App | Hide optional in-meeting notifications](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nvtdlwp/).
### Streamlined raised hand notifications—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android, and Web
Raised hands notifications are now grouped together, for example,_2 people have raised their hand_ , and you’ll no longer receive alerts when hands are lowered.
### Hear the interpreter more clearly—Windows and Mac
During a meeting with simultaneous interpretation enabled, when a participant shares their screen with computer audio, you can now adjust the volume of that shared audio using the simultaneous interpretation volume slider.
See [Simultaneous interpretation in Webex meetings, webinars and Personal Rooms](https://help.webex.com/en-us/o0p0l4/).
### Enhancements to the Join a meeting screen—iPhone, iPad, and Android
We’ve refined the Join a meeting screen to remove any guesswork. You’ll now see clear instructions about what you can enter to find your meeting, along with more accurate search results to ensure you get to the right place quickly and easily.
To try the new experience, tap the Meetings tab in your app and select Join or Join a meeting.
See [Webex App | Join a meeting with a meeting number or video address](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nx9i2ccb/) and [Webex App | Join a meeting using the action button](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nvt0evcb/).
### Enhancements to the Meetings screen—iPhone, iPad, and Android
If your Calendar, Meeting recaps, or Whiteboards tab is empty, you’ll now see a clear explanation of what each tab is for.
We also added quick-start actions to help you get started:
  * Schedule a meeting: Easily set up a new meeting directly from the Calendar tab.
  * Create a whiteboard: Start a new collaborative session directly from the Whiteboards tab.


You can access your Whiteboards in the following locations:
  * iOS: You can find the Whiteboards tab directly within the Meetings tab.
  * Android: You can find the Whiteboards tab by tapping your profile picture to open the menu.


See [Webex App | View upcoming meetings](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nkb6gsk/), [Webex App | Schedule a meeting from the meetings calendar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/wy517z/#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_07b08fde-1929-4df8-a54d-ad7f11b89e02), and [Webex App | Share a whiteboard during a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/vwot6eb/).
### New leave meeting option—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Android
We’ve updated the way you leave your Webex meetings to save you time. You can now choose to skip the extra confirmation step, allowing you to exit a meeting with a single click. You can manage your exit preferences in two ways:
  * In your settings: Navigate to Meetings > Join & Leave and uncheck Ask me to confirm when leaving.
  * During a meeting: When the leave confirmation dialog box appears, check Skip this confirmation next time to disable the confirmation for all future meetings.


Once you have disabled the confirmation step, your experience will be streamlined based on your role:
If you’re a host:
  * Leaving versus ending: To prevent you from accidentally ending a meeting for everyone, you will still be prompted to choose between Leave Meeting or End Meeting when other participants are present.
  * Ending solo: If you are the only person left in the meeting, clicking the exit button will end the meeting immediately.
  * Breakout sessions: You'll return to the main session directly without an extra prompt.
  * Control Hub restrictions: If your organization has enabled a setting to prevent hosts from leaving meetings, you'll only see the option to End Meeting.


If you’re a guest or attendee:
  * Direct exit: You'll leave the meeting immediately upon clicking the exit button.
  * Breakout sessions: You'll still have the choice to leave the session or leave the meeting entirely (unless your host has restricted these options).


If you’re using a paired video device:
  * If your computer is paired with a device (such as a Cisco Desk Pro or Room Device), you'll still be prompted to choose whether you want to leave the meeting on your computer only or on both your computer and the paired video device.


See [Webex App | Skip the confirmation when leaving a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/u9d39j/).
### Enhancements to the Personal Room Meeting screen—iPhone, iPad, and Android
With the redesigned My Personal Room screen, you can now:
  * Copy your meeting link instantly: We’ve added a dedicated option to copy just your meeting link, providing a seamless way to share your room at a moment’s notice.
  * Start meetings quickly: Start a meeting in your Personal Room with a single tap.
  * Share full details: You can still easily share all your meeting join details whenever you need to.


To view the new design, navigate to the Meetings tab in your app. From there, you can:
  * Select My Room if it is displayed upfront.
  * Alternatively, tap the + button in the top right corner of the Meetings tab and select My Personal Room.


See [Webex App | Copy Personal Room meeting information](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nhmd18j/) and [Webex App | Start a Personal Room meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/ngft4sdb/).
### Audio enhancements in Recordings—Windows and Mac
When someone shares stereo audio content in a Webex Meeting, or Webinar, it's also preserved in the recording as stereo. This ensures that those viewing the recording hear the same high-quality audio as live participants. This enhancement may slightly increase the average recording file size to accommodate the stereo audio.
This improvement helps maintain the audio experience in recorded files, making playback more faithful to the original session.
### Webinar support—Windows, and Mac
Webex App now supports up to 5000 attendees for webinars.
### Easily connect to nearby devices—iPhone, iPad, and Android
Stop searching for devices when you join a Webex meeting. We now automatically detect nearby devices directly on the meeting preview page, making it easier than ever to get started.
Instead of hunting for room systems, typing in codes, or navigating through menus, you can simply select your device from the list we've automatically prepared for you. This makes your joining process faster and more reliable, giving you a seamless experience from the moment you start your meeting.
### Easily find a meeting time that works for everyone—iPhone, iPad, Android, and Apple Vision Pro
When you’re scheduling a meeting, the app now suggests available time slots based on your availability and your invitees’ schedules. This makes it easier to find a time that works for everyone.
Hybrid Calendar is required.
See [Webex App | Schedule a meeting from the meetings calendar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/wy517z/) and [Webex App | Schedule a meeting from a space](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nu5w9x3/).
### Use custom GIF reactions in meetings—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Android
Your Webex administrator can now upload up to 10 custom GIF files to use as custom reactions in meetings. You’ll see them when you click Reactions in the meeting controls. 
All meeting participants can send and enjoy these customized reactions, adding a unique touch to your meeting interactions.
See [Webex App | Use reactions in your meetings](https://help.webex.com/en-us/bxg7wz/).
[April (46.4)](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/8dmbcr/What's-New-in-Webex-Suite#reference-template_fdfb497f-d0a8-4612-9cc7-478610c027c0)
### Speaker recognition in meeting recordings—Windows and Mac
When you have a recorded meeting where several speakers are present, AI-generated notes and action items sometimes don't show individual names.
By tagging speakers in the transcript, you ensure that future notes and action items are personalized based on speaker contributions.
### Audio enhancement for recordings—Windows and Mac
Meetings and Webinars preserve stereo audio content in recordings, ensuring that viewers enjoy the same audio experience as the original session.
There may be a slight increase to the average recording size to accommodate stereo content audio.
### Improved post-meeting experience for guests—Windows, Mac, and Web
Now, when guests leave a meeting, they’ll see a redesigned landing page that makes it easier for them to stay connected and engaged. Here’s how your guests can benefit from the new experience:
  * **Share feedback:** Guests can quickly give feedback about how the meeting went.
  * **Explore Webex:** The page offers a brief overview of the benefits of using Webex.
  * **Take action:** Guests can sign up for a Webex account, rejoin the meeting, or download the Webex desktop app.


If you or your organization have [configured a custom URL for your post-meeting landing page](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nk21f0t/), your guests will be directed to that specific page in a new browser tab instead of the default experience.
See [Webex App | Join a meeting as a guest](https://help.webex.com/en-us/49769d/) and [Webex App | Leave or end a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n9hodudb/).
### Start, Join, and Schedule a meeting options are now right on the Meetings tab—iPhone and iPad
We’ve made it easier for you to access meeting options in Webex App. Now, you’ll see Start, Join, and Schedule  a meeting right above your Meetings calendar. They’re no longer hidden under the action button ![Global action button](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/460001-470000/461001-462000/461852.jpg). This means that you can quickly start, join, or schedule your meetings with just one click.
To customize your view, hold any one of these icons until they begin to jiggle. You can then drag and drop them to reorder, and select the check mark in the top-right corner to save your changes. 
Alternatively, you can select the plus (+) icon in the top right to open the menu, choose Reorder  to arrange the items, and then select the check mark in the top-right corner to save your changes.
See [Start a Personal Room meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/ngft4sdb/), [Schedule a meeting from the meetings calendar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/wy517z/), and [Reorder the Start, Join, and Schedule icons](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n7fekgq/).
### Redesigned Meetings tab makes managing your schedule simpler and more intuitive—Windows and Mac
Here’s how you can benefit from the new experience:
  * **Streamlined navigation:** When you’re in the main calendar list view, select any meeting to open a detailed panel on the right. This allows you to review meeting information and handle pre-meeting tasks—such as scheduling, managing invites, or booking rooms—all without losing sight of your overall schedule.
  * **Optimized for your view:** Whether you’re using day or week view, or your app window is smaller, you’ll find an enhanced pop-up window that provides quick access to your meeting details and actions, perfectly tailored to your screen size.
  * **Effortless recaps:** After your meeting concludes, you can easily find and navigate to post-meeting content directly from your Calendar tab. Simply select a past meeting to get started. If you’re using the list view and the second column panel is open, you will find your meeting summary, transcript, recordings, and messages organized under their respective tabs. If you’re using the day or week view, or if your app window is smaller, click Meeting recap  in the pop-up window to open the meeting recap in a separate window, helping you stay caught up and productive throughout the entire meeting lifecycle.


See [Webex App | View upcoming meetings](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nkb6gsk/), [Webex App | Update a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/b52wl1/), and [Webex App | Post-meeting summaries with Cisco AI Assistant](https://help.webex.com/en-us/gkzgoe/).
### Use a virtual or blurred background in calls and meetings—Linux
Limit distractions and maintain privacy around you by blurring or changing your background during your call or meeting. You can replace what shows behind you with a preset background or one of your own.
See [Use a virtual or blurred background in calls, meetings, and webinars](https://help.webex.com/en-us/0p4gb1/).
### High quality video support in meetings—Windows and Mac
Webex App now supports the AOMedia Video 1 (AV1) in your main video window. You don't need to do anything to enable it. 
You can enjoy significantly higher quality, ensuring your video remains crisp and clear during your meetings.
### Decline scheduled meetings—Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android
Looking to keep your calendar neat and up to date? You can easily remove meetings that you've declined or those where the host is no longer with your company. 
It’s a quick and simple way to stay organized and clear out any unnecessary clutter.
### Easily connect to nearby devices—Windows and Mac
Stop searching for devices when you join a Webex meeting. We now automatically detect nearby devices directly on the meeting preview page, making it easier than ever to get started.
Instead of hunting for room systems, typing in codes, or navigating through menus, you can simply select your device from the list we've automatically prepared for you. This makes your joining process faster and more reliable, giving you a seamless experience from the moment you start your meeting.
### Join Webex meetings on your Samsung Galaxy XR device
Use Webex App on your Samsung Galaxy XR device to view upcoming meetings and then join them in a vivid extended reality experience. You can switch between your XR avatar and world-facing camera, resize the app window, and use immersive mode for a larger meeting view when needed.
See [Use Webex App on your Samsung Galaxy XR device](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nxo2t81/).
### Updates for First time experience in meetings—iPhone
We’ve reimagined the first-time experience in the Meetings tab to make it easier, faster, and more intuitive for you to start, join, or schedule meetings. 
Whether you’re brand new or signing in again, you’ll discover clearer action buttons, instant access to your personal room, helpful prompts for setting up your microphone, camera, and calendar, and a guided path to your first meeting—all designed to help you connect with less friction and more confidence.

### Automatically share post-meeting content to Webex App—Windows and Mac
Toggle on Share meeting content in User Hub before a meeting, to automatically share all meeting content to invitees in their meeting recap.
The AI summary, action items, transcript, recording, and meeting chat will be easily accessible in Webex App, no need to search through emails or messages.
The meeting recap will only include content generated during your meeting.

You'll now receive a notification when speaker volume adjustments aren't available for certain devices in **Webex App's** system settings.
### Prevent hosts from leaving the meeting without ending it—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android, and Web
By default, the setting, Allow meeting host to leave the meeting without ending it, is turned on in Control Hub. This means as the host, you can either leave the meeting or end it for everyone. 
If your Webex administrator turns off this setting, you'll only be able to end the meeting—leaving it won't be possible. The feature will always follow the setting chosen by your Webex administrator.
See [Webex App | Leave or end a meeting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n9hodudb/#Cisco_Task_in_List_GUI.dita_924f3df8-6dd9-4f79-b0d2-d47914ef531b).
### Set up a meeting from an action item with Cisco AI Assistant—Windows and Mac
If your meeting summary includes an action item to schedule a meeting, AI Assistant makes it easy for you by suggesting a meeting time, duration, and invitees.
You can review these details, make any changes you need, and let AI Assistant schedule the meeting for you.
See [Schedule a meeting from an action item](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n2jirk2/).
### Enhancements to AI meeting summaries—Windows and Mac
Our new Enhanced layout for your AI-generated post meeting summaries, organizes your summary into two easy-to-read sections: a quick overview, plus a detailed breakdown of specific topics so you can see individual contributions and conclusions.
You'll save hours of time, as you can instantly catch up on what was discussed and keep track of everyone's viewpoints without digging through long transcripts.
See [Post-meeting summaries with Cisco AI Assistant](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/gkzgoe/).
### Skip forward or backward by 10 seconds in meeting recordings—iPhone, iPad, and Android
If you missed a key point or want to jump ahead to the next highlight, you can easily navigate the video playback. Use the skip controls to move forward or backward in 10-second increments, allowing you to review content at your own pace.
See [Webex App | View meeting recordings in your calendar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nqhyg47/#Cisco_Task.dita_8233cf2c-8988-42c0-81d9-ef7db9b0ea55).

### Auto-detection of spoken languages during a meeting—iOS, Android and Web
With this feature, meetings have become even more user-friendly by automatically detecting the spoken language in real-time during a meeting—no need to manually select a language. 
Behind the scenes, AI advanced language recognition system listens to the conversation and identifies what language participants are using. This allows AI Assistant to provide more accurate transcriptions and translations throughout your meeting. For now, the feature supports only one spoken language at a time. 
This feature must be enabled by your organization administrator.
See [Webex App | Auto-detection of spoken language](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nt7sgtg/).
### Notify the host if you join a meeting before them—Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android, and Web
If you find yourself waiting in the lobby, click Notify host to let the meeting host know you’re ready to join. The host will receive an email with a link to start the meeting.
If several people click Notify host—don’t worry—the host only gets one email. This feature is available in both default and custom lobbies.
If you join the meeting after the host has already started the meeting, they'll get a pop-up notification. They’ll also get a sound alert if they've chosen to play a notification sound when someone is waiting in the lobby.
![Lobby of a Design Review meeting](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/490001-500000/494001-495000/494177.jpg)
See [Webex App | Notify the host if you join a meeting before them](https://help.webex.com/en-us/dged6g/).
### Experience a modernized in-meeting interface that matches the new Liquid Glass design for iOS 26 and iPadOS 26—iPhone and iPad
You’ll see updated controls, a refreshed layout, and smooth animations with translucent, blurred, and layered effects. This update makes it easier and more visually engaging for you to manage your meetings and collaborate directly from your Apple device.
### Enable AI Assistant from the meeting scheduler—Windows and Mac
When scheduling a meeting in Webex App, you can enable the AI Assistant to start automatically by selecting this option in the advanced settings of the meeting scheduler.
See [Schedule a meeting from a space](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nu5w9x3/) and [Schedule a meeting from the meetings calendar](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/wy517z/), under Advanced settings > Scheduling options.

#### Auto-detection of spoken languages during a meeting—Desktop
With this feature, meetings have become even more user-friendly by automatically detecting the spoken language in real-time during a meeting—no need to manually select a language. 
Behind the scenes, AI advanced language recognition system listens to the conversation and identifies what language participants are using. This allows AI Assistant to provide more accurate transcriptions and translations throughout your meeting. For now, the feature supports only one spoken language at a time. 
This feature must be enabled by your organization administrator.
See [Webex App | Auto-detection of spoken language](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nt7sgtg/).
#### Copy meeting recording link in Webex App
Webex App will soon introduce a convenient option for users to easily copy recording links from meeting containers. Whether you own the meeting or it’s been shared with you, you’ll be able to discover and copy the recording link in just a few clicks—making it simple to share with colleagues, teams, clients, and partners both inside and outside your organization.
#### Automatically turn off your camera and microphone when your screen locks—Windows and Mac
You can now set the app to automatically turn off your camera and microphone whenever your screen is locked. This helps keep your audio and video private while you’re away.
See [Webex App | Turn off your camera and mic when your screen is locked](https://help.webex.com/en-us/n5e6x5b/).
#### Share computer audio only in a meeting—Windows and Mac
You can now share just the audio from your computer—like background music or any other sound—without having to share your screen or an application. 
During a meeting, click Share content ![Share](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/450001-460000/450001-451000/450684.jpg) > Advanced > Computer audio.
When you only share computer audio, you and the participants see a music note on the stage to let everyone know that audio is being shared.
![Share computer audio only during a meeting](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/490001-500000/493001-494000/493186.jpg)
See [Webex App | Play background music or audio during a meeting without sharing content](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nay9u8w/).
#### See multiple camera angles at the same time from a conference room—Windows VDI and Mac VDI
During a meeting, you can now see up to two video streams simultaneously from the latest RoomOS devices. If the camera mode is set to Group & speaker, there are three or more people in the room, and one of them is speaking, you see both an overview of the room and a close-up of the person speaking.
Requirements: RoomOS 11.23 on Cisco Room Bar Pro, Cisco Board Pro G2, Cisco Codec Pro with Cisco Quad Camera, Cisco Room 70D G2, Cisco Codec EQ, or Cisco Room Kit EQX
See [Group and Speaker mode for Cisco devices](https://help.webex.com/en-us/gzz3q7/).
