To avail of this feature Agents need to [Toggle Manage Webex Calling Calls in Agent Desktop to ON](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/hdoryv/Set-up-and-manage-your-notifications#enable-or-disable-notification-settings). 
  * **If you have one Webex Calling device:**
    * You can answer calls directly from the Agent Desktop—no additional setup needed.
  * **If you have multiple Webex Calling devices:**
    * Go to your **Profile Settings** and select your preferred device for answering calls. Note that the Webex App is a Webex calling device.


![](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/490001-500000/492001-493000/492212.png)
For more information, see [Optimize Webex Contact Center Desktop call notifications](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/u5dbtfb/) and [Set up and manage your notifications](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/hdoryv/).
### Support for Agent variables in Quick replies/Templates
Administrators can now easily populate agent name variables when configuring Quick Replies / Templates for their agents. As part of this enhancement, Admins can leverage the following agent variables: first name, last name, and full name within the Quick Replies. This enhancement enables use cases to add the agent's signature when responding via quick replies, ultimately improving agent productivity.
### Remove the dependency of Contact WrapUp Events
We will enhance the CAR records to include a new Activity State for WrapUp complete. The string for new activity state will be 'wrapup-completed'. This does not impact any existing calculation or reports.
### Callback strategy for Campaign callbacks
Callback strategy of Native campaign manager will give administrators explicit control over how customer-requested campaign callbacks are handled when the callback attempt doesn't successfully connect the customer to an agent.
With this enhancement, administrators and supervisors will be able to configure callback-specific behavior directly in the campaign canvas instead of relying only on standard contact attempt settings. 
Administrators will be able to 
  * Define a dedicated Telephony outcome set for callback
  * Control how callback retries should behave
  * Configure Additional time for callback retries beyond the agreed callback window


This helps Native campaign manager manage callback follow-up more precisely while keeping callback attempts aligned to campaign scheduling rules.
### Webex Contact Center for ServiceNow Integration—Release 1
The new Webex Contact Center for ServiceNow delivers out-of-the-box voice integration, embedding Webex Contact Center telephony and routing directly into ServiceNow’s native Contact Center Integration Framework (CCIF) agent experience. Organizations can use Webex Contact Center as the voice and routing engine while ServiceNow serves as the single pane of glass for handling customer interactions. This integration introduces native call controls, reduces context switching, improves agent efficiency with real-time transcription, and surfaces mid-call and post-call voice summaries directly on the ServiceNow record. It also enables ServiceNow Now Assist to leverage conversation context for richer case assistance and follow-up workflows. Release 1 focuses on voice integration and sets the foundation for future omnichannel expansion.
Key Capabilities 
  1. Native Integration with ServiceNow—Integrates Webex Contact Center telephony, voice, and routing directly into ServiceNow’s CCIF-based agent workspace for a seamless unified experience. 
  2. Enhanced Agent Experience —Provides native call controls in ServiceNow, eliminating context switching and enabling agents to manage calls directly from the record. 
  3. Webex Contact Center-Powered Voice Routing—Enables organizations to use existing Webex Contact Center telephony, routing, WebRTC, and recording capabilities while ServiceNow remains the single agent interface. 
  4. Real-Time Productivity powered by Webex AI—Delivers live transcription plus mid-call and post-call voice summaries directly on the ServiceNow record. 
  5. Now Assist Enabled—Makes conversation context available in ServiceNow to support Now Assist AI-driven workflows, case assistance, and follow-up actions.


### Inline images in email templates and transcripts
Admins can use inline images in email templates and preview inline images in digital interaction transcripts. This helps teams preserve the full context of customer email conversations, including images that appear in messages and historical replies, while continuing to support security controls such as malware scanning and encryption within Cisco boundaries.
### AI-Powered prompt assistance for autonomous AI agents
We are excited to announce an upcoming upgrade to Webex AI Agent Studio designed to simplify and enhance your agent development workflow. We are introducing AI-optimized prompt creation using which you can easily generate a prompt from a simple description, optimize existing instructions using prompt-writing best practices, and review AI-generated changes before accepting them. A new dedicated Instructions tab provides the above capabilities.
These updates help you create clearer, more consistent agent instructions with less trial and error.
### Full Customer Journey View in Analyzer
We are excited to introduce the new Show Full Customer Journey toggle in the Contact Center Overview Historical dashboard helps you view contact metrics across the full journey of an interaction, including movement across queues, agents, consults, transfers, and conferences. Use this view to better understand how end-to-end view of the interaction are handled, while still switching back to the default queue view when needed.
**Expected General Availability date: 20 Aug, 2026**
## September 2026
### Bring your own messaging channel
We'll be launching Bring Your Own messaging Channel (BYOC) in Webex Contact Center, a new capability that lets businesses integrate externally managed custom messaging channels that are not natively supported by Webex Contact Center. With BYOC, developers can inject and update custom channel interactions through APIs, orchestrate messaging flows and routing, relay outbound messages through webhooks, and enable agents and supervisors to handle, monitor, and report on these conversations alongside other channels in a unified contact center experience. 
**Expected General Availability date: 17 Sep, 2026**
### Work Items in Webex Contact Center
Your businesses will soon have the power to manage non-conversational tasks, such as support tickets, backend system tasks, and other custom work items, directly within the Webex Contact Center workspace. By treating these tasks as a first-class channel type, you can route, prioritize, and monitor custom Work Items with the same ease and control as voice and native digital interactions.
**What's coming:**
• **Seamless Integration:** Inject Work Items via API and leverage a consistent omni-channel reporting view that includes all your critical business work items.
• **Unified Task Management:** Agents can handle Work Items alongside voice and native digital interactions in a single, streamlined desktop workspace.
• **Intelligent Routing:** Webex Contact Center Flow Designer is expanding to support Work Items alongside the voice flows currently available, enabling custom self-service and routing logic for your business tasks.
• **Enhanced Visibility:** Supervisors gain new real-time monitoring and reporting capabilities, ensuring complete visibility into agent utilization and task lifecycle progress.
**Expected General Availability date: 24 Sep, 2026**
### Whisper Coach in Supervisor Desktop
Whisper Coach will soon be available in Supervisor Desktop for eligible voice interactions. Administrators can control access by assigning the required permissions to supervisors, enabling authorized users to privately coach agents during active calls.
### Explore Customer Insight Reports in Analyzer
Analyzer is introducing a new Customer Insight Report that helps analysts and reporting users understand customer activity across interactions. The report uses Customer Entity data to bring related customer interactions into a customer-level view, with insights such as frequent intents, primary channel, contact activity, and Auto-CSAT. Teams can use the report to identify repeat contacts, monitor customer effort, spot journey patterns, and better understand where customers may need follow-up or support. Insights are available only for interactions captured from the Beta or GA enablement date onward; historical interactions aren’t included. 
**Expected General Availability date: 3 Sept, 2026**
### Auto-accept digital interactions
Administrators will be able to enable Auto accept interactions in a desktop profile so that assigned agents don’t have to manually accept ACD offered digital interactions. The setting applies to new interactions and interactions transferred to a queue or directly to an agent. It will be off by default, and existing desktop profiles will retain the off setting. The feature requires a Standard or Premium Agent license.
Expected General Availability date: 03 Sep, 2026
### Enhanced digital transcripts in vCon format
Webex Contact Center is enhancing digital transcripts with a standardized vCon format, richer interaction and participant metadata, and complete message payloads. Developers and internal Webex Contact Center services will be able to retrieve point-in-time transcripts for active interactions through a new API and post-interaction transcripts through the Captures API. These enhancements will help support AI capabilities such as summaries, quality management, topic analytics, and sentiment analysis.
**Expected General Availability date: 03 Sep, 2026**
### Configure Business Hours for queue metrics
Administrators will be able to map one Business Hours profile to voice and digital inbound queues. Webex Contact Center will use working shifts, holidays, and working or non-working overrides to calculate Business Hours wait-time and service-level metrics while keeping existing overall metrics available. A referenced Business Hours profile can’t be deleted until its queue mapping is removed.
Expected General Availability date: 03 Sep, 2026

Administrators will be able to enable Evaluations and Speech Analytics for AI agent interactions and manage access to the AI Agent Performance Dashboard. ### Flow Designer MCP server for agentic flow management
Webex Contact Center will soon introduce Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support for Flow Designer, enabling agentic AI apps and automation tools to securely work with Contact Center flows through standardized tooling and interfaces.
This feature provides a governed foundation for agentic flow operations such as flow generation, troubleshooting, validation, and migration, while keeping administrators in control of published changes, organizational access and enabled actions. With this capability, authorized tools can help read, create, generate, update, and validate flows across the organization using agentic app integrations with Flow Designer. This unlocks various bulk administration use cases including bulk searching across flows, making controlled updates across flows including patches and edits.
Customers will onboard this capability through the Webex Agentic Platform. Administrators can enable the Flow Designer MCP server from Control Hub - Agentic Apps settings, with granular control over which MCP tools are enabled for the organization.
### Simplify Automation with Generic Action Fulfillment Flows
We are excited to announce that Generic Action fulfillment flows will soon be available to enhance your automation capabilities. This feature allows you to trigger flows automatically without an entry point.
Designed specifically for quick fulfillment tasks and back-office automation, these flows are ideal for data lookups, complex calculations, and payload transformations. You will be able to utilize a robust set of flow control, utility activities, functions and subflows.
Stay tuned for further updates as we prepare to roll out this new functionality to streamline your workflow logic and data management.
### Personalized AI Routing
We are excited to announce the upcoming launch of Personalized AI Routing for Webex Contact Center. This feature moves beyond rigid, manual routing rules by automatically adapting to real-time contact patterns and workforce conditions, using customer intent and agent insights to make intelligent, dynamic decisions.
**Why It Matters for Your Business**
Personalized AI Routing drives measurable impact by intelligently matching customers to the best-fit agents. Our AI-driven approach delivers:
  * **Reduced Handle Time:** Minimize effort and operational costs by matching customers to the right agent instantly for quicker resolutions.
  * **Increased Customer Satisfaction (CSAT):** Deliver a seamless, personalized experience that builds long-term brand loyalty.
  * **Custom KPI Optimization:** Whether your goal is to boost upsell success or improve conversion rates or any other custom KPI, you can now optimize the outcomes by AI routing for any Business metrics.


Stay tuned for more updates as we prepare to roll out this powerful enhancement to your Webex Contact Center experience.
### AI Assistant for Flow Designer
We're excited to announce the upcoming release of AI Assistant in Webex CX Flow Designer - an intelligent copilot experience that brings in contextual help directly into your workflow during the design process. 
This includes:
  * **Contextual Inline Help** : Get instant, relevant guidance based on your actions or selected components-right where you need it.
  * **Visual Learning Resources** : Access embedded help articles, links, and how-to videos to quickly learn best practices.
  * **Intelligent Search** : Find answers fast with an intuitive search powered by the AI Assistant. Includes support for flow documentation, JSON parsing, Python and JavaScript functions, and more.
  * **User History** : Threads to keep a track of recurring queries.


Why it matters
Traditional workflows require users to switch between the Flow Designer and external documentation, slowing productivity and increasing frustration. The AI Assistant eliminates these pain points by keeping you within the application, reducing time-to-value, and accelerating flow creation with just-in-time help.
**Who Benefits?**
  * **Administrators** : Streamline flow creation and reduce the learning curve.
  * **Developers** : Build, customize, and optimize flows faster with easy to access knowledge.


### AI Wait Time in Webex Contact Center
You can now enhance your contact center’s customer experience with AI wait time, which uses machine learning to provide better estimated wait times. This feature will capture key data points enabling advanced predictive models tailored to customer organizations.
Administrators will have flexible controls, including an organization-level toggle and queue-specific enablement options, to seamlessly manage this capability. AI wait time will be integrated under a unified **AI Features** tab, consolidating Cisco’s Customer Experience AI offerings for streamlined administration and improved operational insights.
## **Supervisor desktop**
  * The Team Performance Details page operates at optimum performance for up to 500 agents. A supervisor with access to more than 500 agents might not experience the best performance with the Team Performance Details page. 
  * When agent 2 is conferencing into a call that is being handled by agent 1, agent 2’s details does not show all the call metadata. Also, when agent 2 is consulting with agent 1, the call details are not available on agent 2’s active interaction details modal. These issues will be fixed in a future release as an enhancement. 
  * The default layout Cisco provides to the Global Layout section doesn’t support cross launching the Webex app. As an alternative, you can customize any of the layouts to add the cross-launch option.
  * When conferencing with a dial number mapped to an entry point wherein 2 agents - agent1 and agent2 are conferencing, the second agent’s contact status displays “Connected” instead of “Conferencing” in the Team Performance Details page. Note that consulting and conferencing a dial number mapped to an entry point is still in limited availability. 
  * There are differences in data between Supervisor Desktop reports and Homepage. For more information, see [Comparison of KPI Cards in Supervisor Desktop and Analyzer](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nqpc4zf/Comparison-of-KPI-Cards-in-Supervisor-Desktop-and-Analyzer).
  * Supervisors must have unique number assignments. Supervisor1 signs into the Supervisor Desktop with a number. Supervisor1 needs to sign out and sign in with a different number, so that Supervisor2 can sign into Supervisor Desktop with the same number used by Supervisor1. If you use the same phone number for different supervisors, contact your account team, partner, or Cisco support for assistance.
  * To save the Inactivity Timeout setting on Control Hub, you must enter a value for the Auto Wrapup interval setting. However, this isn't applicable when you use the Management Portal for tenant level settings.


## **Courtesy callback routing to capacity-based teams is not supported**
Courtesy callback isn't supported with capacity-based teams (CBT). CBTs have no individual agents assigned to them, and courtesy callback requires an Agent ID to function. Therefore, if courtesy callback flows to an entry point or a queue served by a CBT, the call fails.

## May 20, 2026
## Webex Contact Center for ServiceNow CTI connector qualified for ServiceNow Australia release
Webex Contact Center has completed qualification for the ServiceNow Australia family release for the Webex Contact Center for ServiceNow CTI connector.
The ServiceNow Store listing now shows Australia compatibility for the [Cisco Webex Contact Center CTI Connector](https://store.servicenow.com/store/app/3fe073a61ba46a50a85b16db234bcb44) for ServiceNow, enabling customers upgrading to ServiceNow Australia to continue using Webex Contact Center voice workflows inside ServiceNow.
Australia is an important ServiceNow release because it reinforces two paths for Webex Contact Center and ServiceNow customers: continued support for the current CTI OpenFrame-based connector, and the forward-looking CCIF-based integration path. CTI connector provides the established embedded connector experience today, while CCIF brings next-gen Webex Contact Center voice and routing deeper into ServiceNow’s native contact center framework for a more unified agent workspace experience.
This qualification covers the current CTI connector while also validating the CCIF-based integration in Beta, where Webex Contact Center is the primary voice and routing engine, and ServiceNow remains the primary agent workspace with native call controls and deeper workflow context.
## Decommissioning of Dial Plans
Dial plan configuration is being removed from desktop profiles and Control Hub. As of **May 25, 2026** , new customers no longer see dial plan configuration in desktop profiles or as a separate Control Hub configuration. Starting **June 25, 2026** , existing customers will also no longer see or manage dial plan configuration, and the related API will be decommissioned.
This change removes an unsupported configuration experience to reduce confusion and improve the Control Hub administration experience.
## March 23, 2026
## Removal of Contact History Widget from Default Agent Desktop Layout
The Contact History widget will be deprecated from the Default Agent Desktop Layout effective May 15, 2026. The Contact History widget was originally developed to provide agents with a view of past interactions.
Since the Contact History widget provides limited capabilities, we have decided to invest in the Customer Journey widget, which is more comprehensive in terms of the features supported and provides a progressive profile and full omnichannel interaction history for deeper context. Please note that this change only affects the default layout; customers using custom desktop layouts will continue to be able to use the Contact History widget without impact.
## March 11, 2026
## Webex WFO: Manage Workflow Control Sets on the Web
Webex WFO is moving Workflow Control Set management from the WFM client to the web for a more streamlined, browser-based administration experience. For more information refer to [Manage workflow control sets and profiles in the web](https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/wfm-settings/manage-workflow-control-sets-web.htm).
This functionality will transition to the web-based platform through a phased rollout between March 31, 2026, to April 6, 2026. Effective April 6, 2026, all WFM workflow control set operations will be exclusively managed via the web portal. To maintain uninterrupted service, ensure that all WFM workflow control sets are fully migrated by this date.
This change supports simpler access, centralized control, and ongoing platform modernization.

## August 19, 2025
## End of Support for Analyzer Beta from Webex Contact Center
Webex Contact Center ended support for the Analyzer Beta on August 19, 2025. The Analyzer Beta was originally developed to enhance the application's usability. 
Since the Analyzer Beta supported limited capabilities, we have decided to invest in simplifying and improving the usability of the current Analyzer, which is more comprehensive in terms of the features supported and is the primary application used by most of the users. 
## July 14, 2025
## Webex Contact Center Incident and Maintenance Notifications Moving to the Global Service Status Page
Starting August 1, 2025, Webex Contact Center will consolidate its incident and maintenance notifications under the [Global Service Status](https://status.webex.com/) page. After this date, notifications for incidents, maintenance windows, and occasional complex feature rollouts will no longer be sent via CJPIM email or Webex room notifications.

For updates on feature releases, you can subscribe to the [What’s New](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nv7abhz) and [Coming Soon](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nv7abhz/What's-new-for-administrators-in-Webex-Contact-Center#topic_D8159C942D4EE10D3C86F7C043C86722) help pages.
Please visit these pages and subscribe to ensure you continue to receive important notifications related to Webex Contact Center. ## June 26, 2025
## Data Explorer Shutdown in Webex WFO
The shutdown timeline for Webex WFO’s Data Explorer has been extended from June 30, 2025 to July 30, 2025. After July 30, 2025, customers will no longer have access to Data Explorer and are expected to leverage Webex WFO Insights for all reporting needs. With the recent launch of Classic WFM datasets, this extension provides Classic WFM customers with additional time to familiarize themselves with Insights and move comfortably to the new reporting experience. 
Here is a summary of Webex WFO Insights:
Insights is a modern, fully-featured BI solution with a range of features and improvements designed to significantly enhance your data access and visibility within Webex WFO.
**Reasons to get excited about Insights** :
  * The Insights experience is designed for streamlined data exploration and analysis, while being easy for non-technical users to independently create reports and dashboards.
  * Highly customizable to help accelerate decision making
  * Offers a broad range of visualizations
  * Suitable for both efficient ad-hoc analysis and rich dash-boarding.


Here is a short video to provide an overview of the capabilities that Insights brings to the table: <https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/insights-bi/get-started/how-insights-works.htm?tocpath=Data%20Analysts%7cInsights%7c_____1>
If your organization has already completed the transition to Insights, you also have the option to manually disable Data Explorer before it is automatically decommissioned. For more information, see <https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/insights-bi/turn-off-data-explorer.htm>

## September 25, 2024
## End of support for VPOP provisioning for new Webex Contact Center tenants 
The Webex Calling PSTN services add-in for Webex Contact Center was introduced earlier this year. This add-in allows Webex Contact Center customers to selfprovision SIP trunk connections directly in Webex Control Hub using Local Gateway functionality.
The Local Gateway replaces functionality previously provided by VPOP for new customers. The add-in also provides Contact Center customers access to Cisco Cloud connected PSTN providers.
With the general availability of the Webex Calling PSTN services add-in, Cisco will be removing the ability to provision new VPOP based contact centers. For all new Webex Contact Center orders Control Hub can be used to provision telephony integration.
This change won’t affect existing VPOP customers who can continue to use VPOP integrations currently. Cisco will communicate directly with VPOP customers in the future as Cisco transitions VPOP services.For more information on Webex Contact Center telephony integration, see [Set up voice channels for Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/2dputx/Set-up-voice-channels-for-Webex-Contact-Center).
## September 4, 2024
## End of Service announcement for Webex Contact Center Legacy Media Platform
Webex Contact Center introduced its next generation voice media platform over two years ago. The Real Time Media Service (RTMS) has delivered many new capabilities to our customers, including regional media support, WebRTC based agents and caller background noise removal. 
Over the last year, Cisco has been transitioning customer onto this new platform. This process is now almost complete and therefore we are announcing the retirement of our legacy voice media platform. The last day of operation for the legacy media platform will be 30th November 2024. All customers must have completed their transition to Real Time Media Service (RTMS) before this date.
Customers can check their operational media platform in Webex Control Hub. Selecting “Contact Center” and then “General” from Tenant Settings will show the current voice media platform. Current voice media platform should read “Real Time Media Service”. If this field contains any other value, please contact your partner or customer success manager with urgency to facilitate your transition to RTMS.
## July 25, 2024
## Exciting Update: Webex Contact Center Licensing Consumption and Reporting
We are pleased to announce an important update on [Webex Contact Center Licensing Consumption and Reporting](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n9vhuwe/Webex-Contact-Center-license-consumption-and-reporting).
This updated article now includes enhanced sections on **Viewing Usage** and **How is Usage Determined?**. Additionally, we've introduced a new **Frequently Asked Questions** section to address common inquiries. This section covers topics such as the capabilities and limitations of surge protection, and clarifies that while it is currently not possible to entirely prevent overage charges, efforts are underway to develop a solution.
As mentioned in the article, these updates will be available across all Webex Contact Center data center regions by August 2024.
Thank you for your continued support as we strive to provide you with the most comprehensive and transparent service possible.
## July 17, 2024
## Discontinuation of Routing Strategies for New Tenants
Webex Contact Center will be discontinuing support of Routing Strategies for any new tenant onboarded on or after July 17, 2024. We recommend new tenants use Business Hours as an alternative. Existing customers may continue to modify their routing strategies; however, we strongly recommend managing schedules through Business Hours for existing customers as well. _We will announce the dates for deprecating the Routing strategies soon and will give appropriate time for customers to transition to business hours. Until then, there will be no impact to the Routing Strategies functionality for existing customers_.
For more information on Business Hours, see [Set up business hours for Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/dqekw4).

We are streamlining our recording management portal to enhance your experience. As part of this effort, we have phased out the custom attributes feature. You can take advantage of our tagging system. Tags offer a similar experience, enabling you to easily organize and identify your recordings.

What's new for supervisors in Webex Contact Center
![list-menu](https://help.webex.com/images/feedback.svg)Feedback?
We want to make sure that you know about the major updates made available in Webex Contact Center for supervisors—updates to the interface, new functionality, and ways to supervise your agents. 
For detailed information on Webex Contact Center release types and schedule, please visit [_release schedule_](https://help.webex.com/en-us/nlm1x6q) article.
For all historical announcements before 2024, and announcements related to Administrators, see [What's new for administrators in Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nv7abhz).
For announcements related to Agents, see [What's new for agents in Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n3v7ldh/).
  * [What's new](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/o6f77s/What's-new-for-supervisors-in-Webex-Contact-Center#whats-new-supervisor)
  * [Coming soon](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/o6f77s/What's-new-for-supervisors-in-Webex-Contact-Center#coming-soon)
  * [Limitations](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/o6f77s/What's-new-for-supervisors-in-Webex-Contact-Center#limitations)
  * [Announcements](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/o6f77s/What's-new-for-supervisors-in-Webex-Contact-Center#announcements)


## July 30, 2026
## Schedule Call Monitoring from Supervisor Desktop!
We are excited to announce that Call Monitoring capabilities are now available in your Supervisor Desktop! 
You can now set up call monitoring sessions in advance directly from Supervisor Desktop. You can create monitoring requests for specific queues, teams, or agents, choose when the monitoring should start and end, and use recurring schedules when needed. When a matching call starts and you’re logged in, Webex Contact Center offers the monitoring call so you can listen from the beginning. For more information, see [Schedule call monitoring](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/5k9gxcb/Schedule-call-monitoring#manage-listening-schedules).
Customers who still have the granular agent state control feature disabled will see only the global Schedule Listening button, not the option in the agent row.
With the official sunset of the Tenant Management Portal (End of July, 2026), the existing monitoring schedules in the portal will not be migrated. You must recreate your active schedules in the Supervisor Desktop.
## July 23, 2026
## Webex AI Quality Management: Enhance evaluation precision in AI Quality Management
We are excited to announce the following enhancements to AI Quality Management designed to provide supervisors with greater control and accuracy in evaluation workflows. Supervisors can now configure **Auto-fail** thresholds for critical sections in evaluation form, offering deeper visibility into interaction-level and aggregated agent-level reporting. We are also introducing a **Not Applicable** option, allowing for more nuanced evaluations where specific criteria may not apply, alongside a new **Test Question** feature that enables supervisors to validate and refine questions before publishing evaluation forms.
For more information see the [Create an Evaluation Form](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nxvdoq2/Use-Evaluation-and-Speech-Analytics-in-Webex-AI-Quality-Management#task-template_d8da7458-fec1-4dba-b767-72f11ebf621f) and [View Evaluation Scores](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nxvdoq2/Use-Evaluation-and-Speech-Analytics-in-Webex-AI-Quality-Management#concept-template_a41bd293-ad51-4bd8-9552-e4c618b9137a) sections in the _Use Evaluation and Speech Analytics in Webex AI Quality Management_ article.
A Webex AI Quality Management SKU is required to enable these capabilities.
## July 22, 2026
## Webex WFO: WFM - Adherence Connector Enhancement for Granular Agent States
Webex WFO now introduced an enhanced WFM adherence connector to support the new Webex CC granular agent states feature. This update integrates with a new Webex webhook, enabling more precise tracking of multi-channel agent activity. Granular agent states are scheduled to roll out to all Webex CC customers on October 29, 2026.
**Get Ahead of the Change: Adopt the New Connector Now**
You can move to the new WFM adherence connector before the October 29 cutover, and we recommend doing so early. Adopting the connector now gives your team more time to reconfigure adherence state groupings, schedule the change during a maintenance window, and reduce the risk of Real-Time Adherence (RTA) reporting interruptions when granular agent states are enabled. 
  * Moving to the new connector requires re-grouping your adherence state configurations to align with the updated connector, but does **not** require enabling the granular agent states feature. 
  * Enabling granular agent states is optional until the October 29th rollout and can be turned on whenever you're ready. 
  * You can choose to re-group your states and enable granular agent states at the same time, or handle them as separate steps on your own timeline whichever works best for your organization. 


**Important Impact and Preparation**
Once granular agent states are enabled, either voluntarily before October 29 or automatically at the cutover, existing state grouping configurations will no longer align with the new multi-channel agent states. If your state groupings have not been reconfigured using the new adherence connector, RTA reporting will be interrupted until the reconfiguration is complete. 
We recommend reviewing the [**_Webex WFO Webhook Change Preparation Guide_**](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/2t8a2h/Webex-WFO-Webhook-Change-Preparation-Guide) ahead of the release date for detailed planning steps and a walkthrough on reconfiguring your state groupings. If you require further assistance, please contact Cisco Support.
## Webex AI Quality Management: Reporting for Interaction Quality and Team Performance
Analyzer now introduced quality management reporting for completed interactions and human agent performance. We are enhancing the existing CSR Report - Yesterday to include quality management metrics, such as evaluation scores, customer sentiment score, Auto CSAT and speech analytics—including dead air time, cross-talk, and word ratios—across interactions. Furthermore, we are introducing the new "AI QM Team Performance Report," which offers a centralized view of your team’s performance metrics aggregated at agent level, including evaluation scores, speech analytics, and average handle time. These updates provide a comprehensive, data-driven foundation to help you monitor quality, optimize operations, and make informed decisions with ease.
A Webex AI Quality Management SKU is required to enable these capabilities.
## July 09, 2026
## Unified Reporting for Webex Contact Center and Webex Calling
We have now introduced the Unified Call Summary Report in Analyzer, designed for organizations that use both Webex Contact Center and Webex Calling. This new stock report uses a shared Interaction ID to link Contact Center and Calling records, giving supervisors a single place to track a call's end-to-end journey across both platforms. With this report, you can view Contact Center KPIs such as handle time, queue time, agent details, and disposition and drill down on any Interaction ID to see the associated Calling-side Call Detail Records (CDRs), including call duration, ring time, transfer count, and hold time, along with call outcomes after a transfer such as whether the call was answered, refused, or redirected.
## June 25, 2026
## New Visual Experience for Analyzer
We have now introduced a fresh, modern visual refresh for the Analyzer interface, aligning it with the standardized design language used across the Webex Contact Center. This update also adds the flexibility to switch between Light and Dark mode to better suit your workspace preferences.
The overall Analyzer experience remains the same. You can continue to create, view, and use reports and dashboards as you do today. As we transition to this updated look, please note that legacy custom themes and a few formatting options will no longer be supported.
Some unsupported formatting options may still appear temporarily in the updated look, but they will not be applied when reports and dashboards are viewed. The previous look will remain available for a limited time and will be retired soon. These unsupported formatting options will be retired along with the previous look. For more information, see [Change the Visualization Output Format](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/tajemk/Cisco-Webex-Contact-Center-Analyzer-User-Guide#task_F82BAFC832B5055F02E402DFCCE786F3).
## Weighted Agent Insights routing
We’ve enhanced Webex Contact Center routing engine with Weighted Agent Insights routing, designed to improve how interactions are matched to agents.
This update uses Dynamic Skills, which represent agent-level attributes assigned directly to agents, to help the system make more relevant routing decisions. Supervisors can continue to use skill profile-based reskilling, while also benefiting from the ability to update Dynamic Skills directly on agents. By considering Dynamic Skills alongside other skills, contacts can be matched with agents whose attributes best fit the needs of the interaction.
What this means for your operations:
  * **Improved Matching** : Contacts can be routed to agents with the most relevant attributes for the interaction.
  * **Direct Agent Reskilling** : Update Dynamic Skills directly on agents, while continuing to use skill profile-based reskilling for existing skills.
  * **Greater Routing Flexibility** : Dynamic Skills help teams adapt routing behavior more quickly across queues and contact types.


These changes are intended to give teams more flexibility in managing queues and help ensure interactions are handled by the most suitable available agents.
## June 11, 2026
## KPI Cards in Webex Contact Center Analyzer
We are excited to introduce KPI Cards, a new chart type for Webex Contact Center Analyzer designed to streamline performance tracking in Analyzer. This feature allows users to build custom metric cards, apply color-coded thresholds and also added them to dashboards. These capabilities provide a flexible and intuitive method for the real-time monitoring of critical contact center performance indicators. For more information, see [Create a Visualization](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/tajemk/Cisco-Webex-Contact-Center-Analyzer-User-Guide#task_9859A41E3B4D2D4020D4E0D96AED6EF4).
## June 10, 2026
## Webex WFO: Auto Coaching in Performance Management
Webex WFO Performance Management has introduced Smart Coaching, a new feature that automates the creation of coaching sessions based on specific business rules and performance thresholds. By leveraging real-time data, Smart Coaching ensures that agents receive timely, personalized feedback while significantly reducing the administrative burden on supervisors.
**Key Benefits:**
  * Automates session creation, freeing supervisors from manual scheduling tasks.
  * Triggers coaching precisely when performance metrics indicate a need for intervention.
  * Provides agents with consistent, relevant guidance tailored to their individual performance.
  * Strengthens the feedback loop, ensuring that performance goals are tracked and addressed consistently.


For more information , see [Create rules for automatically scheduled coaching sessions in Performance Management](https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/performance-management/auto-coaching.htm).
Performance Management requires customers to sign in through their configured Tenant Specific URL. For more information, refer to [Tenant Specific URL for Webex WFO Users](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nw6wf91/Tenant-Specific-URL-for-Webex-WFO-Users).
This feature requires a minimum of Webex WFO Bundle SKU, or Full WFM, or Full QM. For more information pertaining to Webex WFO SKUs, see [_Webex WFO: Feature Specific SKUs_](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/py6u9h/Webex-WFO:-Feature-Specific-SKU).
## Webex WFO: WFM - Manage External Log-on in the Web
Webex WFO has enhanced external log-on management by adding web-based capabilities alongside existing client support. External log-ons link agent statistics from systems like Automatic Call Distribution (ACD), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), or Payroll and are automatically updated every night. Agents can have multiple external log-ons, but sharing them is not recommended to maintain accurate per-agent statistics.
For more information, see <https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/people/manage-basic-user-info.htm>.
This update enables administrators and users to manage external log-ons directly via the web interface, streamlining work flows while retaining client functionality. It supports improved usability and administrative efficiency in workforce management.
This feature will be available on both the web interface and the client application, maintaining full functionality across both platforms.
## June 03, 2026
## Enhanced Supervisor Desktop: Redefining the Experience
**Under admin-controlled until August 06, 2026**
We’re excited to announce enhancements to the Supervisor Desktop in Webex Contact Center. This enhancement provides a unified workspace where you can configure, manage, and govern supervisory tools and settings from a single, intuitive interface. With robust role-based access controls and modular capabilities aligned to your organization's licensing, you'll have greater control over what your teams can see and do. 
**What’s enhanced:**
  * **UX reorganization:** A more intuitive layout designed to reduce friction, allowing supervisors and administrators to toggle seamlessly between monitoring, workforce, and configuration tasks. 
  * **Landing page customization:** Users can now set their preferred default landing page, ensuring the metrics and tools most relevant to their daily workflow are immediately accessible. 
  * **Expanded feature scope:** Users can access Topic Analytics and AI Quality Management (QM) features directly from Supervisor Desktop, when enabled for your organization and based on access privileges. 
  * **Granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):** Ensures that the interface remains secure and uncluttered by aligning visibility and functionality directly with the user’s specific role, license, and credentials. 


## 28 May, 2026
## Faster Wrap-up with AI-generated Reasons
Reduce after-call work and improve reporting accuracy with intelligent auto-suggested wrap-up reasons . AI Assistant can now suggest the most relevant wrap-up code from your administrator-defined list at the end of each interaction. No changes to your taxonomy, just smarter guidance at the right moment.
For more details, see the [Streamline Wrap-Up with AI-Generated Wrap-up Reasons](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ndt475w/Enhance-your-efficiency-using-AI-generated-summaries#concept-template_569e064c-6609-4750-9b4a-53b15ec5fb50) section in the Enhance your efficiency using AI-generated summaries article.
## May 21, 2026
## Safe calling window for call recipients
Safe Calling Window is now available in Native campaign manager to help teams start outreach earlier without losing protection for recipient-local calling hours. It improves clarity around when contacts become callable and helps reduce idle time for agents at the beginning of the workday.
A new 'Safe calling window' configuration is now available in the 'Contact attempt strategy' node.
**Example use case:** Consider a debt collection campaign where agents work from '8:00 AM' to '5:00 PM' Central Time. A single contact has three phone numbers in 'Eastern', 'Mountain', and 'Pacific' time zones. 
  * Configure 'Campaign timings' as '8:00 AM' to '5:00 PM Central'. 
  * Configure 'Safe calling window' in Contact attempt strategy node as '6:00 AM' to '8:00 PM' in the contact’s local timezone.


At '8:00 AM Central', that contact is at '9:00 AM Eastern', '7:00 AM Mountain', and '6:00 AM Pacific'.
Since all three numbers are already within the configured safe calling window, the contact can be sent to the dialer right at the start of the agent’s shift. This means agents can begin working on available contacts sooner instead of waiting for the latest timezone on the record to reach a safer default threshold.
## April 30, 2026
## Webex WFO: WFM - Intraday Re-forecasting
Webex WFO now supports WFM Intraday Reforecasting, a powerful enhancement that enables supervisors to realign staffing throughout the day based on the latest demand. By quickly generating and implementing revised forecasts, teams can efficiently address unexpected events like call surges or agent absences with increased precision and flexibility.
This functionality enhances intraday management, supporting contact centers in boosting service levels, minimizing both overstaffing and understaffing, and ensuring well-balanced schedules. With unlimited reforecasts accessible directly from the Intraday Staffing view, supervisors can make informed, data-driven staffing decisions seamlessly, without interrupting current workflows. 
For more information,see [View staffing levels and actual need](https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/intraday/view-staffing-actual-need.htm).
## Webex WFO: New Media Player Interface
Webex WFO now supports a refreshed Media Player interface designed for a cleaner, more intuitive user experience. This transition from dense, static panels to a sleek, modular design, the new UI ensures that essential information is available exactly when needed , reducing visual clutter and improving workflow efficiency.
**Key Benefits:**
  * **Modernized Aesthetic** : Updated styling and a refined color palette provide a fresh, contemporary look.
  * **Flexible, Modular Layout** : Easily expand or collapse sections to optimize your screen space and maintain focus on the task at hand.
  * **Contextual Metadata** : Information is displayed on-demand, ensuring you have the data you need without overwhelming your view.
  * **Personalized Viewing** : Use a centralized menu to quickly show or hide key elements, such as Transcripts, Audio, Sentiment, and Phrase Hits.


For more information, see [Play contacts with the new media player](https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/media-player/v2/media-player-v2.htm).
## Webex WFO: WxCC Consulted Agent Display and Search Capabilities
Webex WFO now supports improved visibility into consultations within interactions for customers. Users can view up to ten consulted participants directly within interaction metadata, including both agent and non-agent participants. 
From the Interactions page, users can filter by consulted agents and participants, and customize columns to display relevant consultation details. Agent participants are listed by name, while non-agent participants are identified by their calling number, making it easier to understand and analyze multi-party interactions within the contact center. 
For more information, see [View consultation participants within an interaction ](https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/application-management/acd-webex-cc-2.0-view-consultations-agents.htm)
## Webex WFO: WFM - New Forecasts Viewing Page
Webex WFO now supports a new Forecasts Viewing page on the web that brings enhanced visualization of forecast charts alongside workload and skills interval data for specific skills, combining capabilities currently available in the WFM client. This new web page will operate alongside the existing web forecast page, providing users with flexible options for viewing forecast information and enabling a seamless transition of these features to the web platform.
Editing capabilities for forecast workload and skill data will be available on this page, including convenient copy and paste functionality within the workload and skill grid components. 
For more information, see [Forecasts tool (web)](https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/glossaries/wfm-tools/forecasts-web.htm)
The client version of the forecast page will continue to be supported and will not be retired.
## Granular Agent State Control by Media Type
**Under admin-controlled until October 29, 2026**
This feature provides consistent, accurate visibility and control of agent state for each media type—Voice, Chat, Email, and Social—across all Webex Contact Center interfaces. Agents can manage their availability per channel, giving them greater flexibility when handling interactions, while supervisors can monitor agent readiness in real time.
Until October 29, 2026, your administrator controls whether this feature is enabled or disabled for your organization.

## December 19, 2025
## Native Webex Campaign Management: APIs for managing contact lists
We are introducing the following 5 APIs which will help you automate the process of creating and managing contact lists associated with your campaigns:
  1. [Create contact list](https://developer.webex.com/webex-contact-center/docs/api/v1/contact-list-management/create-contact-list)
  2. [Create contacts within a contact list ](https://developer.webex.com/webex-contact-center/docs/api/v1/contact-list-management/create-contacts-within-a-contact-list)
  3. [Get contact lists within a campaign](https://developer.webex.com/webex-contact-center/docs/api/v1/contact-list-management/get-contact-lists-within-a-campaign)
  4. [Update a contact's status within a contact list](https://developer.webex.com/webex-contact-center/docs/api/v1/contact-list-management/update-a-contact-s-status-within-a-contact-list)
  5. [Update contact list status](https://developer.webex.com/webex-contact-center/docs/api/v1/contact-list-management/update-contact-list-status)


The documentation for these APIs is available on [Webex for Developers API Reference](https://developer.webex.com/webex-contact-center/docs/webex-contact-center) portal.
With these APIs, you can automate the creation and management of your campaign contact lists without the need for a human user to manually upload the contact lists. You can also support use cases such as the following scenario: let’s say a bank’s core debt accounting system every morning generates a file of customers whose debt payment is overdue, and this file is then used to automatically create a contact list for a ‘debt-collection campaign’ using the SFTP upload method. During the day, one of these customers may make the debt instalment payment online or in a bank branch office. In this case, you can write an application to invoke the 4th API in the above list to ‘close the contact record’ for this customer who no longer needs to be called as their debt payment is no longer overdue.
## Native Webex Campaign Management: Advanced (more granular) campaign scheduling
Previously, the ‘Basic campaign schedule’ had the following limitation: although it allowed you to enable or disable the campaign schedule for a specific day of the week, the campaign’s start-time and end-time needed to be the same for every day for which the campaign schedule is enabled.
Now, we have introduced the ‘Advanced campaign schedule’ which will allow you to configure up to three different campaign time slots for each day of the week. You can now schedule campaigns to reflect your real-world business scenarios. For example, multiple contact center shifts, lunch-breaks, half-days on Saturdays etc.
This feature will be visible in the 'Daily schedule' node on the 'Campaign canvas'. 
## Native Webex Campaign Management: Associate different 'Wrap-up code settings' with different campaigns
We are introducing the ability to create multiple ‘Wrap-up code sets’, thus unlocking the ability to configure different call retry setting and contact-closure setting values for the same wrap-up code. Thus, you can now potentially associate a different ‘wrap-up code set’ with each campaign. This enables you the granular control you need to tailor wrap-up code settings to the unique requirements of each campaign, leading to more targeted retry strategies. 
For example, let's say a bank has two debt collection campaigns—one for mortgages and another for auto-loans. The mortgage department may want to 'close the contact' if the wrap-up code is 'Customer promised to pay', but for the auto-loan department's campaigns, for the same wrap-up code, they may want to keep the contact open and retry after 1 day. With this feature, you can easily configure this requirement. 
You can create up to 100 'wrap-up code sets'. 
## Native Webex Campaign Management: Associate different 'Telephony-outcome settings' with different campaigns
We are introducing the ability to create multiple ‘Telephony outcome sets’, thus unlocking the ability to configure different call retry setting and contact-closure setting values for the same telephony-outcome. Thus, you can now potentially associate a different ‘telephony-outcome set’ with each campaign. This enables you the granular control you need to tailor telephony-outcome settings to the unique requirements of each campaign, leading to more targeted retry strategies. 
For example, let's say a bank has two debt collection campaigns—one for mortgages and another for auto-loans. The mortgage department may want to retry after 1 hour if the telephony-outcome is 'Phone is busy', but for the auto-loan department's campaigns, for the telephony-outcome, they may want to retry after 2 hours. With this feature, you can easily configure this requirement. 
You can create up to 100 'telephony-outcome sets'. 
## Native Webex Campaign Management: Infer a contact’s timezone from their US Postal Service ZIP code
This feature is only applicable to clients in the USA.
Until now, the timezone for a US-based call recipient was derived from that contact’s phone area code(s) to ensure the outbound call is made within a ‘Safe Calling Window’ within the overall campaign schedule. However, as customers move from one city/town to another, they are very likely to keep their mobile phone number – thus the timezone inferred from the phone area code can be incorrect.
With the introduction of this feature in ‘Field Mapping step #5’, you will now have the option to _“Derive timezone from contact list: Based on US ZIP codes”_. We have mapped each of the approximately 42,000 ZIP codes in the USA to a timezone. So if you select this new option while configuring ‘Field Mapping step#5’, then the system will infer the timezone for each contact from their ZIP code, instead of inferring the timezone from their phone area code.
This feature may help you to improve your outbound campaign efficiency and improve your compliance with ‘calling window’ regulations.
## Native Webex Campaign Management: Block all calls to specific US ZIP code(s) from all campaigns
This feature is currently in 'Beta' and applicable only to clients in the USA.
We already have a feature that allows you to block calls from all active campaigns to one or more specific telephone area codes within the USA. This feature is very useful if, for example, the authorities declare a civil emergency within a certain area due to some natural disaster.
Now we are introducing a similar feature (currently in ‘Beta’) that will allow you block calls from all active campaigns to one or more specific ZIP code within the USA. This can potentially enable you to more precisely adhere to state and city regulations or business rules at a more granular level.

## October 29, 2025
## Simplified sign-in experience for supervisors
The launch of the 'Simplified sign-in experience for supervisors' feature, initially scheduled for October 15, 2025, has been moved to **October 29, 2025**. This short postponement enables us to implement feedback from Early Access, ensuring a smoother and more reliable experience for you. You do not need to take any action; this adjustment is made to guarantee a better overall experience.
We are introducing a simplified and more efficient sign-in experience for supervisors who use the Agent Desktop in Webex Contact Center. This enhancement aims to streamline the sign-in process and reduce errors, especially when using pre-populated or drop-down credential options. While these improvements minimize mistakes and routing problems for most users, supervisors should be aware that the system performs validation on the credential itself (for example, ensuring it's a valid format and assigned to your profile), but does not perform a real-time device status check at sign-in. Therefore, it is your responsibility to ensure your selected or entered dial number or extension is associated with an active and available device.
This enhancement includes:
  * **Smarter sign-in options** : The sign-in screen now dynamically displays only the options relevant to your profile.
  * **Pre-populated credentials** : If your profile includes a single configured dial number or extension, this information is automatically pre-filled. For profiles with multiple configured options, a drop-down is available, saving you time and reducing the risk of mistyped information.
  * **Webex Calling validation** : For Webex Calling users, validation is performed to ensure that extensions or dial numbers selected from the drop-down are valid and assigned to your Webex Calling profile. This helps ensure you select a correct credential, minimizing routing issues caused by incorrect or unassigned credentials. If you manually enter an extension or dial number, the system will still check if the credential is assigned to you, but no real-time device status check is performed at sign-in for any entry (drop-down or manual). It is your responsibility to ensure the selected or entered extension or dial number is associated with an active and available device. This approach maintains flexibility for supervisors who use extensions not configured in Webex Calling, but it is your responsibility to ensure the extension is available and ready for use.
  * **"Don’t show this again" feature** : The **Don’t show this again** check box allows you to skip the station selection screen during subsequent sign-ins. Once selected, the system will perform an auto sign-in, bypassing the station selection step. You can still clear this option at any time under **Change Profile Settings** to be presented with the station sign-in screen again if needed.


![Enhanced Supervisor UI](https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/490001-500000/491001-492000/491950.png)
**Benefits**
  * **Faster and easier sign-in** : A streamlined process reduces sign-in time, allowing you to start work quicker.
  * **Minimized errors** : Pre-populated credentials and validation for drop-down selections help eliminate issues caused by mistyped information or invalid details _for the credential itself_. However, the system does not perform a device status check at sign-in, so it remains the supervisor’s responsibility to ensure device availability.
  * **Improved call routing** : Accurate sign-ins for validated credentials ensure seamless call routing and an enhanced customer experience. Supervisors must ensure their selected or entered credential is associated with a correctly configured and available device to avoid potential routing problems.


These enhancements are designed to improve usability and reduce errors for most sign-in scenarios by validating the credentials themselves. However, the system does not perform a device status check at sign-in. Therefore, it is the supervisor's responsibility to ensure the selected or manually entered extensions or dial numbers are associated with an active and available device to prevent disruptions.
For more information, see <https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/lc7emx/Sign-in-to-Supervisor-Desktop> and <https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nydkuvdb/Change-your-role-in-Supervisor-Desktop>.

These changes are designed to seamlessly incorporate new functionalities such as the ability to search for and select interactions, view real-time queue statistics, and access an enhanced interactions tab. These improvements will be introduced gradually as new features become available, with broader availability anticipated in the month of July.

## Enhanced Agent Desktop Task List for Supervisors
We're introducing an updated Task List for agents in the Agent Desktop, designed to give your team a more organized and efficient way to manage customer interactions. This enhancement will streamline agent workflows and provide clearer visibility into their workload.
**What's new for your agents?**
  * **Streamlined tabbed design:** Agents will benefit from a new 2-tabbed layout in their Task List:
    * **Active:** Provides a quick overview of all currently active interactions.
    * **Closed:** Offers a chronological log of recently finished conversations across all channels.
  * **Improved interaction overview:** Agents gain a comprehensive, single-pane view of all incoming and ongoing interactions, enabling better prioritization and workload management.
  * **Supervisors with Agent roles:** If you also handle customer interactions, you will directly experience these Task List enhancements in your Agent Desktop.


This update empowers your agents with a clearer, more organized interface, leading to improved individual efficiency and better overall team performance. By simplifying interaction management, agents can prioritize more effectively, reduce response times, and enhance customer satisfaction, directly contributing to your team's success.
For more information, see [Understand Supervisor Desktop user interface](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nbgsy8x/Understand-Supervisor-Desktop-user-interface).
## Real-time queue statistics in Supervisor Desktop
We’re excited to introduce real-Time queue statistics feature in the Supervisor Desktop app that provides supervisors with a centralized and actionable view of queue performance through a dedicated Queues tab. This tab offers a single point of access for all queue-related information and allows supervisors to personalize their queue list by selecting, arranging, and filtering columns to display the most relevant metrics. Real-time queue data is presented in visually appealing formats—such as tables, charts, or graphs—for quick and easy assessment of queue status. Supervisors can drill down into queue details, examine agent status, view current interactions, and directly assign or remove agents (for agent-based queues) from the dashboard, ensuring efficient queue management.
For more information, see [Supervise and manage Contact Center queues](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/b1qhidb/Supervise-and-manage-Contact-Center-queues). 
## Manage direct agent assignment to queues from Supervisor Desktop 
Supervisors can now assign or remove agents directly from queues within the Supervisor Desktop using the new Queue page, without needing to access Control Hub. This functionality is available exclusively for Agent-Based Queues, streamlining queue management, enabling faster real-time adjustments, and providing supervisors with greater flexibility to manage workforce distribution efficiently.
For more information, see [Supervise and manage Contact Center queues](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/b1qhidb/Supervise-and-manage-Contact-Center-queues). 
## Comprehensive Interactions Details View with transcripts
We are introducing an enhanced, full-page Interaction Details View in the Supervisor Desktop, providing supervisors with a comprehensive overview of customer interactions. This new view enables access to both live and completed transcripts for voice and digital (chat) interactions. 
Voice transcripts are available for customers with topic analytics enabled and for calls with available transcripts.
In addition to existing recordings, supervisors can leverage real-time transcripts, a detailed interaction data panel—including timings, duration, hold time, and handle time—and a customer journey view across channels and days. This enhancement empowers supervisors with richer data for improved monitoring, analysis, and understanding of customer engagements.
For more information, see [Interactions details view in Supervisor Desktop](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/iba8xp/Interactions-details-view-in-Supervisor-Desktop).
## New Interactions tab in Supervisor Desktop 
We’re replacing the Recording Management area with the all-new Interactions tab, providing supervisors a clear, real-time view of customer interactions at every stage. 
This enhanced feature includes three tabs:
  * **Active Interactions:** Monitor live conversations in real time. 
  * **In-Queue Interactions:** See interactions waiting in queues.
  * **Completed Interactions:** Access past interactions and recordings with ease.


The customizable table allows supervisors to filter and organize data, making it simple to track ongoing cases and review completed interactions—all designed to boost efficiency and responsiveness.
For more information, see [Supervise your agents and teams](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n408h9cb/Supervise-your-agents-and-teams).
## Update Agent Skill Profiles from Supervisor Desktop
We are excited to introduce a new feature that allows supervisors to update an agent’s **Skill Profile** directly from the **Supervisor Desktop** within the **Team Performance Details** view. 
This enhancement empowers supervisors to make real-time adjustments for agents under their scope, streamlining operations and reducing reliance on admin workflows. Also, Supervisors can edit agents' skill profiles in real time and view key skill profile details such as **Skill Name** , **Skill Type** , and **Skill Value** to make informed decisions quickly.
This feature is role-based and requires admin-granted access, ensuring secure and controlled usage.
For more information, see [Supervise your agents and teams](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n408h9cb/Supervise-your-agents-and-teams).
## Create Powerful Formulas with the Simplified Formula Builder
In an effort to increase the usability of the Analyzer tool, we are excited to introduce a major enhancement to the Analyzer tool that makes building custom formulas easier, faster, and more powerful. With the new text-based formula editor, users can create complex formulas using any number of fields from their reports, combined with arithmetic operators and aggregate functions. The editor provides guidance throughout the formula building process, helping users validate the formula built. That is not all, users can to save these formulas for future use within the same report or even save them as global formulas to use across all reports within their organization. This update is going to provide users with greater flexibility, consistency, and efficiency to build custom formula in Analyzer tool.
For more information, see [Cisco Webex Contact Center Analyzer User Guide](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/tajemk/Cisco-Webex-Contact-Center-Analyzer-User-Guide#topic_217E73D0D2DB0100877B85951B90571C).
## Color Coded Thresholds—Highlight What Matters
We are excited to announce the feature—Color-Coded Thresholds that brings powerful visual clarity to the custom reports. This new capability allows users to highlight specific values in a report based on user-defined threshold conditions, making it easier to quickly identify positive or negative outcomes for key metrics. Users can define up to 10 threshold conditions per report using a range of comparison operators such as Greater Than, Less Than, Equal To, Between, and more. These conditions drive dynamic color formatting, applied in a top-down sequence based on the logic you set. Best of all, thresholds can be created, edited, or removed at any time-without ever altering the underlying data. It's a simple yet powerful way to enhance visibility, spot trends faster, and make decisions with greater confidence.
For more information, see [Cisco Webex Contact Center Analyzer User Guide](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/tajemk/Cisco-Webex-Contact-Center-Analyzer-User-Guide#topic_3BA24389C591DEC677329422227CB62F).

## April 21, 2025
## Webex WFO: Activity Requests 
Activity Requests is now live in Webex WFO, enhancing Agent Self-Scheduling by allowing agents to request time for non-scheduled activities such as training, administrative tasks, and development opportunities—directly within their schedules.
Automation is playing a key role. When an agent adds an activity, the system handles the request according to predefined rules:
  * Auto-approved activities are instantly approved by the system.
  * Manually approved activities remain in a pending state until a team lead reviews and approves them.
  * Staffing-dependent activities are automatically approved or denied based on real-time staffing levels.


Key benefits:
  * Reduce manual effort with automated approval workflows.
  * Ensure scheduling decisions align with staffing needs and business priorities.
  * Maintain oversight and flexibility while enabling a more agile, self-directed workforce.


For more information, see [Configure Activity Rule Settings](https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/wfm-settings/configure-activity-rule-settings.htm).

## Improve Workforce Efficiency using Webex WFO Notifications 
Notifications is an enhancement in Webex WFO designed to improve awareness and response for both agents and supervisors.
Key use cases supported by Notifications: 
  * **Shift Bidding Window Closing Notifications** - Agents who haven’t placed their bids receive alerts 24 hours before the deadline via the MyTime Web App, Mobile App, and browser notifications. This helps optimize shift allocations and prevents missed bids. 
  * **Absence Request Notifications** - When an agent submits a time-off request through the Request Module, their team lead or supervisor receives a persistent in-app notification, pop-up notification, or system push notification.
The system applies rules to auto-approve, deny, or waitlist the request. If no rule applies, the request remains Pending, triggering a notification for supervisory review. Since these notifications operate at the team level, any transferred agent’s new supervisor automatically receives the request for action.


**Benefits** :
  * Delivers timely notifications 
  * Enhances the scheduling efficiency 
  * Reduces administrative workload
  * Ensures seamless communication between agents and supervisors. 


For more information, see the following topics:
  * [Notification Settings](https://www.wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/wfm-settings/notification-settings.htm)
  * [Display User Info](https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/people/display-user-info.htm)
  * [Manage Basic User Info](https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/people/manage-basic-user-info.htm)
  * [Configure Organization Hierarchy](https://wfohelp.com/doc/Content/user-guides/wfm-settings/configure-organization-hierarchy.htm)

## February 11, 2025
## Cisco AI Assistant for Contact Center 
Get ready to transform your contact center operations and delight your customers with Cisco AI Assistant for Contact Center! 🌟 
AI Assistant revolutionizes customer service by enhancing your efficiency and elevating customer satisfaction! 🚀 
Here's what the AI Assistant offers: 
  * **AI-generated call summaries** at various touchpoints throughout agent-customer interaction. 
  * **AI-powered Agent Wellbeing** to support agent’s wellbeing, improve productivity and Customer satisfaction.
  * **Auto CSAT** predicts customer satisfaction after each interaction, providing insights that help contact centers make smarter decisions, improve agent performance, and boost customer satisfaction. 


For more information, see [Cisco AI Assistant for Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nvvv1zb/). 
## AI-generated call summaries 
Agents can now handle customer conversations better with AI-generated summaries. 
  * **AI-generated summaries for dropped calls:** If a call gets disconnected unexpectedly, the Cisco AI Assistant instantly creates a summary of the conversation. When the customer calls back, the next agent can seamlessly continue the conversation, saving time and enhancing the customer experience. You can view insights and assess the importance of these summaries in the _Dropped Call Summaries_ report on the _AI Assistant Dashboard_. For more information, see [_Dropped Calls Summary_](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ioqbvd/#concept-template_37459087-0a71-48d7-838d-ccfab25dc656) report. 
  * **Virtual agent transfer summaries:** Provides the comprehensive summaries of interactions with virtual agents, ensuring the agents have all the information needed to assist customers quickly and efficiently. This means less repetition for customers and faster resolutions! 
The Analyzer report for the virtual agent transfer summaries will be available in the future.


For more information on the AI-generated call summaries, see [Enhance your efficiency using AI-generated summaries](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ndt475w). 
## Agent Wellbeing 
AI-powered Agent Wellbeing features are designed to support Agents’ wellbeing, enhance productivity, and customer satisfaction. Using advanced analytics, the Webex Contact Center platform harnesses end-to-end data insightsto monitor and detect agents' stress levels in real-time. Using the real-time insights, the system provides **automated wellness breaks** when needed, helping agents manage stress effectively, sustain high performance, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. 
For more information, see [Improve agent wellbeing and performance with burnout detection and wellness breaks](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/l5eu0c). 
## Auto CSAT 
Auto CSAT predicts customer satisfaction (CSAT) after each interaction, helping contact centers gain insights and make decisions to boost customer satisfaction and agent performance. CSAT is crucial for understanding customer happiness with service. Cisco's proprietary Auto CSAT model uses operational data, interaction transcripts, and surveys to predict CSAT scores accurately. These scores can identify training needs, select calls for review, and ensure swift resolution for dissatisfied customers. You can view the Auto CSAT scores in the **Auto CSAT** report on the **AI Assistant Dashboard** within the Analyzer. 
For more information, see [_Measure customer satisfaction with Auto CSAT_](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/l59wt8).

## May 14, 2024
## Refresh intervals and High Cardinality fields
During custom report creation, selecting high cardinality fields, such as Agent Session ID and/or Contact Session ID as row segments and/or column segments triggers a UI prompt with additional information. This pop-up indicates that appropriate filters need to be applied to these two high cardinality fields for an optimal reporting experience.
Realtime Reports supports refresh intervals starting from 5 seconds and above for better optimization and a seamless experience. Existing reports with refresh intervals less then 5 seconds defaults to 5 seconds as the new refresh interval, and it can be changed to other available values greater than 5 seconds. New reports default to 5 seconds as the refresh interval, and it can be changed to other available values greater than 5 seconds. Refresh intervals of less than 5 seconds is not available for any reports, to improve reporting performance.
